title: SEO Engineer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Technical SEO Developer who can implement SEO changes directly, not just recommend them. THIS IS A FULL TIME ROLE.



This role is for someone comfortable working inside CMS files, templates, and codebases to improve crawlability, performance, and keyword rankings. If your experience is mainly content SEO, reporting, or tool-based optimization, this role will not be a good fit.



What You Will Do

 • Audit and implement technical SEO fixes related to:

 • Crawlability and indexation

 • Site architecture and internal linking

 • Canonicalization and rendering issues

 • Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile performance

 • Work directly within:

 • WordPress (themes, plugins, core files)

 • Shopify (Liquid templates, SEO constraints, performance)

 • PHP-based platforms (e.g. OpenCart or similar)

 • Implement structured data and technical enhancements at code level

 • Optimize websites for traditional search and AI-driven search experiences (GEO / GSEO)

 • Take ownership of ranking performance and SEO KPIs

 • Use SEO tools to diagnose issues, but rely on implementation, not automation alone



Required Skills & Experience

 • 3+ years of hands-on technical SEO implementation

 • Comfortable editing live websites and templates

 • Working knowledge of:

 • HTML, CSS, JavaScript (rendering understanding required)

 • PHP and Shopify Liquid

 • Experience working directly inside:

 • WordPress, Shopify, and PHP-based e-commerce platforms

 • Strong understanding of:

 • Google Search Console

 • Ahrefs / Semrush

 • Screaming Frog, Lighthouse, GTmetrix

 • Able to clearly explain why SEO actions are taken and how they affect rankings

 • Good command of spoken and written English



Nice to Have

 • Experience with SQL or Python / Node.js for SEO automation

 • Practical exposure to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AI search)

 • Proven examples of technical changes leading to ranking improvements



Important Notes

 • This is not a strategy-only or reporting-only role

 • Candidates who rely mainly on plugins, widgets, or third-party apps without understanding the underlying technical mechanics will not be suitable

 • You must be comfortable implementing changes yourself

Systara LLC is an AI implementation and operations consultancy. We help small and mid-sized businesses organize their CRM systems, automate workflows, manage lead pipelines, and build practical reporting systems. Our clients include service businesses across several industries.



The Role



We are looking for a technically capable GoHighLevel and AI Automation Systems Assistant. This is not primarily a social-media or basic administrative role. You will help build, troubleshoot, document, and maintain the systems that support Systara and its clients.



Deep, hands-on GoHighLevel experience is the first priority. You should also have practical experience connecting business processes to AI and automation tools. The right person will be organized enough to manage follow-ups, documentation, open issues, and routine operational work without needing constant supervision.



Responsibilities



You will build and troubleshoot GoHighLevel workflows, pipelines, funnels, forms, calendars, custom fields, custom values, tags, and
 or SMS follow-up systems. You will maintain client subaccounts, test automations before launch, diagnose failures, and keep system documentation current.



You will also help develop AI-assisted workflows using tools such as OpenAI, Claude, n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs, and webhooks. These workflows may classify leads, summarize requests, route information, draft internal outputs, update CRM records, or alert a team member when human review is required.



As Systara’s systems assistant, you will organize incoming requests, maintain standard operating procedures, track open tasks and technical issues, prepare simple KPI reports, and communicate proactively when instructions are unclear or a system needs attention.



Required Qualifications

• Strong hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, especially workflows, pipelines, funnels, calendars, forms, custom values, lead follow-up, and troubleshooting



• Experience supporting live client accounts or production business systems



• Ability to test your own work and explain how you prevent duplicate actions, missed leads, incorrect routing, and broken automations



• Clear written English and professional client communication



• Strong organization, documentation, and independent problem-solving skills



• Reliable internet and consistent availability for 20 hours per week





Strongly Preferred

• Practical experience with n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs, or webhooks



• Experience using OpenAI or Claude inside real business workflows—not only using ChatGPT for writing



• Experience supporting a marketing, consulting, automation, or operations agency



• Experience creating SOPs, tracking KPIs, and managing technical requests



• Familiarity with
 marketing, SMS compliance, A2P 10DLC, or CRM data hygiene





How to Apply

Please answer every question below. Generic applications that only list tools will not be prioritized.



1. What is the most complex GoHighLevel system you personally built? Explain the business goal, workflow logic, integrations, and which parts you completed yourself.



2. Describe a difficult GoHighLevel problem you diagnosed and fixed.



3. Describe one AI-powered workflow that you personally implemented for a real business or client. What tools, inputs, outputs, and safeguards did it use?



4. Which of these have you used hands-on: n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs, webhooks, OpenAI, Manus or Claude?



5. How would you organize multiple client requests, open system issues, SOPs, and KPI reporting for Systara?



6. Confirm your desired hourly rate, current client workload, weekly availability, and whether you are open to increasing your hours later.





We value specific examples, clear explanations, honesty about your current skill level, and applicants who can explain not only what they built, but why it works and how they tested it.

title: Long-Term YouTube Vlog/Documentary Video Editor
description:
[HIRING] Long-Term YouTube Video Editor — Japanese Street Drifting / Car Documentary Channel — $
/Video



Hard Requirements (Please do not DM/apply if you're not a right fit)

1. Fluent English — You need to fully understand dialogue, voiceover, humor, context, and subtle storytelling cues.

Adobe Premiere Pro — All projects are edited in Premiere Pro. We will pass project files back/forth so I can make changes but mostly leave comments for the following revision

2. Strong Storytelling Ability — This is the most important requirement. You need to understand pacing, tension, buildup, payoff, retention, and when to let a moment breathe. I’m looking for a storyteller who edits, not just someone who can cut footage pls

3. Creative Editing & Sound Design — Strong instincts for music, SFX, ambience, transitions, B-roll, visual storytelling, and creative sequences. You should be able to take relatively ordinary raw footage and find ways to make it engaging, cinematic, and entertaining without over-editing it. Also the occasional high quality cool drifting compilation paired with music.

4. Skilled in Face & License Plate Blurring/Tracking — You must be very good at accurately tracking and blurring faces and license plates. And noticing things in the background that need blurring as well. This needs to be done thoroughly throughout our street drifting videos.

5. Car/JDM/drifting knowledge is a huge plus.



Hi there, it's been a long time coming, and I need some serious help on the editing front for my YouTube channel (Name: BrokeButRich. Second Channel: DriftWithRich). I'm looking for someone to work with for the LONG TERM. In the ideal world, I can pass up ~90% of the editing to you, but for now, and at least at the start, I'll probably still be writing the script and telling the story. 



My videos follow Japanese street drifting/car culture and include cinematic footage, vlogs, VO, interviews, music and compelling storytelling. I've attached an example of a timeline for a high level street drifting documentary - if you think you can handle something like that, please apply :)

A good example of a high end documentary style video is one of my latest videos: 

-Not every video will be like this, some will be heavier on the storytelling rather than spectacle



I have 2 channels right now, one for all the high-level production street drifts/documentaries and a 2nd channel for lower-key, simpler videos that I'm hoping you'd be able to bang out without my input (simple vlogs or fixing up the car).



Budget: Up to $250/video if we can get to the near fully autonomous point with little of my own input/editing. Also as the channel grows, which I have big plans for this next year, so will my editor's pay ofcourse.

Volume: As many videos as you can handle (I'm backlogged about 16 videos right now). But a minimum of 2 videos a month (ideally 3-4 though)



Please save us both some time and only apply if you're seriously interested in a long term partnership. Also if you're seriously qualified. I've been editor-hunting for too long now and I need it stop 😂



To apply, message me here and tell me your dream car you'd buy so I know you actually read this in full.

-I will send you a test edit heavier on the storytelling side. Do what you can with my comments/notes, and if things work out, we'll finish the video and you'll get paid the full amount. If you give me a legit first draft/edit, but we don't proceed, I will pay you ~25USD for your time. Payment will always be AFTER the video is finished. No half/half, partial upfront, etc.

description:
Video Editor for YouTube Commentary Channel



I’m looking for a skilled video editor to help edit content for The Uzo Show, a growing YouTube commentary channel focused on politics, culture, relationships, current events, and viral topics.



The editing style should feel similar to channels like MTR, Anton Daniels, Oshay Duke Jackson, and Brandon Lehman — clean, engaging, professional, and fast-paced without unnecessary animations every few seconds.



What You’ll Be Editing



Most videos will consist of:



Me reacting to or commenting on another video

Talking-head commentary

Split-screen reactions

News clips, TikToks, interviews, or viral videos

Occasional monologues

Your Responsibilities



You should be able to:



Remove mistakes, repeated sentences, awkward pauses, filler words, and dead space

Clean up awkward reactions or facial expressions when possible

Make my commentary flow naturally even if the raw recording is imperfect

Tighten pacing and remove anything that makes the video feel slow

Add strategic zoom-ins, punch-ins, and camera changes

Insert supporting screenshots, headlines, images, clips, or B-roll when appropriate

Add captions/text when it improves the video

Balance and improve audio

Understand comedic timing and commentary pacing

Turn raw footage into a polished video without needing constant instructions



I do not want excessive animations, sound effects, memes, or distracting edits. The personality and commentary should remain the focus.



Workload



Initially: 5–10 videos per week



Eventually: 10–15+ videos per week



Most videos will be approximately 10–30 minutes finished length.



This can grow into a consistent long-term position for the right editor.



Schedule



Approximately 25–30 hours per week to start.



Pay



Starting at approximately $700/month, depending on skill, speed, availability, and experience.



There will be opportunities for increased pay as the channel and workload grow.



Requirements

Strong English comprehension

Experience editing YouTube commentary, podcasts, reactions, or talking-head content

Fast turnaround

Reliable communication

Good judgment — you should know what to cut without destroying the speaker’s point

Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or similar professional editing software

Must be comfortable receiving large raw video files

TO APPLY



Send me:



2–3 examples of your best talking-head, commentary, reaction, or podcast edits

What editing software you use

Your typical turnaround time for a 15–20 minute finished video

Your internet speed

Your current availability

Start your application with the words “UZO SHOW” so I know you read the entire post.



Applicants who appear qualified may be given N editing test before being hired.

title: Purchasing Assistant
description:
Job Overview



We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Purchasing Assistant to support our purchasing and procurement operations.



You will assist with supplier communication, purchase orders, pricing and product information, shipment coordination, and purchasing records. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with spreadsheets, communicating with suppliers, and following up on multiple orders and deadlines.



Key Responsibilities:

- Assist with day-to-day purchasing and procurement activities.

- Communicate with suppliers regarding product availability, pricing, lead times, order quantities, and shipment status.

- Prepare, issue, and maintain purchase orders (POs).

- Follow up with suppliers to ensure orders are processed and shipped according to schedule.

- Perform other purchasing and administrative duties as assigned.



Requirements:

- Previous experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain, inventory, eCommerce, or a related administrative role is preferred.

- Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

- Comfortable using Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

- Good organizational and follow-up skills.

- Able to manage multiple purchase orders and deadlines simultaneously.

- Able to communicate professionally and confidently with suppliers.

- Responsible, proactive, and able to work with minimal supervision.



Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience communicating with overseas or China-based suppliers.

- Experience with platforms such as Alibaba, 1688, or other supplier sourcing platforms.

- Experience with inventory management or ERP systems.

- Familiarity with international purchasing, shipping, and basic import/export processes.

- Experience working in an eCommerce or retail environment.

title: Video Editor & Content Producer
description:
Video Editor & Content Producer



25–35 Hours/Week | Long-Term | Sport, Events & E-Commerce



We’re an Australian company looking for a talented Video Editor & Content Producer to become a long-term part of our creative team.



We’re looking for approximately 30 hours per week, with flexibility around working hours. For the right person, there is potential for the role to grow.



This is not a role where you simply wait for someone to tell you where to make every cut.



We want someone who can take raw footage, understand what we’re trying to achieve, identify the strongest stories and hooks, and turn it into engaging content quickly.



You’ll work across two very different businesses, which means the content is varied and there is always something new to create.



WORLD OCEAN SERIES — SPORT & EVENTS



We run a growing Australian ocean sports and events series.



Our team captures a huge amount of content around our events: elite racing, athlete stories, interviews, behind-the-scenes footage, B-roll, crowds, entertainment, sponsors, activations and everything happening around the event.



We want to dramatically improve the speed at which that raw footage becomes great content.



You might create:



* Fast-paced race highlights

* Athlete stories and profiles

* Behind-the-scenes content

* Reels, TikToks and Shorts

* Event hype videos

* Sponsor content and activations

* Event recaps and highlight packages

* Longer-form storytelling

* Content promoting the entire event experience — live sport, music, food, entertainment and atmosphere

* Multiple versions of content for different audiences and platforms



You don’t need to already understand ocean sports.



But you do need to understand sport, competition and storytelling — and be a quick learner.



Over time, we want you to know our athletes, events and storylines well enough that you can look through footage and identify what matters without us having to explain everything.



You’ll also work directly with the people shooting our content.



We want you to be able to say:



“We need more of this.”



“Next event, let’s capture this angle.”



“There’s a story here.”



“Give me more athlete reactions and less generic B-roll.”



You won’t just sit at the end of the production process. You’ll help us make the whole process better.



E-COMMERCE & AD CREATIVE



We also operate a fast-growing e-commerce business.



Here, the objective is different.



We need a constant pipeline of fresh, engaging advertising creative.



You’ll work with product footage, UGC, photography, existing ads and new content to create and test different ideas.



This could include:



* New hooks and opening sequences

* Multiple variations of successful ads

* UGC edits

* Product-focused ads

* Graphic overlays

* Motion graphics and simple animation

* Different music, pacing and messaging

* Fresh angles using existing footage

* Testing different lengths and formats

* Rapidly iterating on creative that is performing well



You should understand that an ad isn’t just a nice-looking video. It has a job to do.



Sometimes that’s stopping the scroll.



Sometimes it’s generating a click.



Sometimes it’s explaining a product.



Sometimes it’s creating desire.



Sometimes it’s taking something that’s already working and producing five intelligent variations to see if we can make it work even better.



We want someone interested in understanding why content performs, not just whether it looks good.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Technical editing ability matters, but we’re looking for more than someone who knows editing software.



We want someone who:



* Has excellent instincts for short-form content

* Understands hooks, pacing, retention and storytelling

* Understands sport and competition

* Can identify interesting moments in raw footage

* Can work without needing every edit mapped out

* Can create multiple variations quickly

* Understands the difference between organic content and performance advertising

* Can use graphics, text, overlays and animation where they improve the content

* Is comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly

* Can learn our brands, athletes and audiences

* Is organised with large volumes of footage

* Can work directly with the people filming our content

* Is interested in improving the entire production workflow, not just editing individual videos

* Is curious about what performs and why



We care about speed AND quality.



We don’t want someone spending an entire day perfecting a 20-second Reel that could have been excellent in two hours.



We also don’t want someone pumping out mediocre content just to hit a volume target.



Our goal is to build a production system where great footage becomes great content fast.



HOURS & WORKING WITH US



This is an ongoing, long-term role averaging approximately 25–35 hours per week.



There is flexibility around your working hours.



We’re much more interested in finding an excellent person than forcing a traditional 40-hour work week.



However, we’re not looking for someone who occasionally picks up editing jobs when they have spare time.



We want someone who can become a consistent part of our team, learn our businesses deeply and take increasing ownership of our content production.



If the relationship works well, there is plenty of opportunity for the role to grow.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Initially, we’ll provide more direction while you learn our businesses.



But over time, we want to be able to send you a folder containing footage from an event and have you start saying:



“This is a story.”



“This could make a great Reel.”



“There are three different pieces of content in this footage.”



“We should create several versions of this.”



“Next time, the camera team should capture this angle.”



Likewise, with our e-commerce creative, we want you looking at what’s performing and thinking:



“Why is this working?”



“What happens if we change the first three seconds?”



“Can we create five new versions without needing another shoot?”



That’s the level we’re trying to build toward.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send us a generic application.



Start your application with the words:



OCEAN EDITOR



Then send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your portfolio or showreel.

3. Your three best examples of short-form content you personally edited.

4. One example of content you edited specifically to sell a product, service or event, if you have one.

5. Tell us which editing software you use.

6. Tell us about any experience you have editing sport, events, e-commerce, UGC or performance advertising.

7. Tell us how many hours per week you’re currently available.

8. Tell us your expected monthly salary in PHP based on approximately 30 hours per week.



Finally, answer this:



THE QUESTION WE CARE ABOUT MOST



You receive 90 minutes of raw footage from a major sporting event. There are races, athletes warming up, interviews, crowds, sponsors, music, food and behind-the-scenes footage. Nobody gives you an edit list.



What would you do first, and how would you d
 what content to create from it?



We’re much more interested in your answer to that question and the quality of your previous work than a long résumé.

title: Long-Term Online Early Childhood Educator / Homeschool Learning Guide
description:
Long-Term Online Early Childhood Educator / Homeschool Learning Guide



Remote / Online — Part-Time — Long-Term

Child: 4 years old

Family: Queensland, Australia (2 hours ahead of the Philippines)



We are looking for a warm, creative educator to work one-on-one online with our 4-year-old son and ideally become a consistent part of his education for several years.



This is not a standard tutoring role based around worksheets or delivering the same prepared lessons to every child. We want someone who gets to know him, follows his interests, plans specifically for him, and gradually helps guide a broad education as he grows.



About him

------------------



He is now 4, at home most of the time, and has not had formal preschool education.



He speaks reasonably well once engaged and loves being read to, including longer 20-minute stories. Recent favourites include Richard Scarry, Hairy Maclary and Dr. Seuss.



His strongest interests currently include:



* cars, tow trucks and vehicle recoveries

* building and construction

* seeing how things work

* watching people make and repair things



We would like to use these interests as gateways into broader learning.



For example, a tow-truck recovery might lead into reading, counting, drawing, storytelling, maps, simple physics, history, building something, problem solving, or discussing how the people involved might think and feel.



Education

------------------



Our immediate formal priority is learning to read. He is just beginning and does not yet know all his letters.



We would particularly value experience with early literacy, including letter sounds, phonemic awareness, systematic phonics, blending, early spelling, writing and reading.



Importantly, he already loves books. We want to build on that rather than turn reading into endless flashcards and worksheets.



Over time, we want a broad education covering areas such as:



* reading, writing and communication

* biology, health and understanding his body

* understanding emotions, his mind and basic psychology

* problem solving and reasoning

* creativity, art and making things

* engineering and building

* practical life skills and independence

* general knowledge

* mathematics

* science, including basic physics

* geography and, increasingly as he gets older, basic history



History at this age would mostly follow his interests — for example, how early cars such as the Ford Model T were built and how cars, engines, factories and roads changed over time. Like most topics, they should follow his interests and weave in the fundamentals through those.



Just as importantly, we want to develop curiosity, problem solving, creativity, emotional resilience, persistence, flexible thinking, communication, independence, observation, spatial reasoning and confidence with mistakes.



Learning style

------------------



We are interested in Montessori, Reggio Emilia, play-based, project-based and child-led learning, without needing to follow any philosophy rigidly.



Although lessons are online, we want learning to happen in the physical world as much as possible.



You might both draw, paint, cut and glue, build with cardboard or blocks, use toy cars, make maps, count objects, conduct simple experiments or work through a construction problem together.



We can prepare materials at home and, where useful, buy duplicate materials so you can both work on the same project over video.



Books and educational materials will have a separate family-funded budget, with flexibility for worthwhile resources and projects.



Emotional development

------------------



Emotional development and life skills are important parts of the role.



He can become frustrated when something is difficult or doesn’t work as expected. We want someone who can remain calm and connected, help him understand what he is feeling, work through problems, tolerate mistakes and gradually develop persistence and emotional regulation.



We value co-regulation and guidance rather than shame, punishment or forced compliance. This is not a therapy role; we simply want emotional skills integrated naturally into his education.



Filipino languages

------------------



Our son is half Filipino but has not yet learned that side of his languages.



English and general education are the priorities now, but over time we may introduce Cebuano/Bisaya and possibly Tagalog through conversation, stories and everyday activities.



These languages are a bonus, not a requirement.



Schedule

------------------



We expect to start with approximately:



* 30 minutes of direct learning each weekday

* 5 days per week

* additional paid planning and preparation time



This will depend on his attention and comfort and is intended as a starting point.



As he develops a relationship with the educator, we can see this gradually increasing toward 1–2 hours of learning per day, divided into shorter sessions rather than one long class. It may increase further as he gets older.



Initially, we anticipate approximately 10 paid hours per week in total, including teaching, planning and preparation.



Planning might include designing activities around his interests, preparing materials, planning literacy development, recommending books, keeping simple progress notes and adapting future lessons.



Long-term

------------------



We are looking for someone willing to commit for at least one year and ideally several years.



As he grows, the position could gradually develop from early-childhood education into broader homeschool education, with increased hours.



Continuity matters to us. We would rather find one excellent educator who knows him well than continually change tutors.



Who we’re looking for



Relevant experience may include:



* early-childhood / preschool / kindergarten education

* elementary education

* early literacy or systematic phonics

* Montessori or Reggio Emilia

* play-based or project-based education

* homeschooling

* child development



Formal qualifications are useful but not mandatory.



More important is someone who genuinely enjoys young children, speaks excellent English, is warm and patient, listens to the child, follows his interests, can improvise, asks interesting questions, encourages curiosity, and can design engaging activities rather than relying heavily on worksheets.



You should also be comfortable with the reality that a 4-year-old will not always sit still or follow the planned activity.



Compensation

------------------



Please tell us your preferred hourly or monthly rate.



All agreed teaching, planning and preparation time is paid.



Books and learning materials are funded separately.







How to apply

------------------



Please do not send only a generic résumé. We want to learn a little about you without making the application unnecessarily time-consuming.



1. Brief introduction



Please tell us:



* where in the Philippines you are based

* your religion

* relevant education/training

* experience with children aged approximately 3–6

* experience teaching early reading

* any Montessori, Reggio Emilia or play-based experience

* whether you speak Cebuano/Bisaya or Tagalog

* normal availability in Philippine time

* expected hourly or monthly compensation



2. Short video — 1–5 minutes



Please record a simple video speaking directly to our son as though you were meeting him for the first time.



He loves cars, tow trucks, building things and stories.



You might introduce yourself, show or tell him something interesting, or mention something you would enjoy reading, building or discovering together.



We are not evaluating appearance or video quality. We simply want to see your natural spoken English, warmth and way of engaging with a young child.



3. Mini lesson challenge



Imagine he is currently fascinated by tow trucks and vehicle recoveries.



What would you do with him for a 20–30 minute session?



It could involve reading, letters, maths, science, art, building, storytelling, history or anything else.



We aren’t looking for a formal lesson plan. We want to see how you turn something a child loves into learning.



4. Frustration scenario



You and he are making a cardboard vehicle together. It repeatedly falls apart.



He becomes frustrated, pushes it away and says:



“I can’t do it!”



What would you do next?



5. Long-term



Imagine you continue working with him from age 4 until age 6 or 7.



How would you hope his education — and your role in it — develops over those years?



Selection



We will shortlist applicants based on the overall application, particularly:



* how engaging you are with our son

* creativity and educational thinking

* approach to emotions and frustration

* natural communication with a young child

* long-term fit

* experience and knowledge

title: Business Loan Sales Consultant / Closer — Warm Leads — AU Day Shift
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Have you sold business loans, mortgages, asset finance or insurance? Bring your closing experience to Ezy Pzy Finance and help Australian business owners access funding.

We also welcome proven sales professionals from other industries who can demonstrate consistent target achievement and experience closing business over the phone.

You’ll receive warm enquiries, product training, weekly coaching and the opportunity to earn commission on both new and repeat clients.





YOUR EARNING OPPORTUNITY



•During probation: AUD $500/week + commissions + bonuses (approx. ₱97,500/month fixed base). After 8 weeks probation: AUD $650/week including PhilCare allowance + commissions (approx. ₱126,750/month fixed pay).

• Our agents currently average AUD $5,200/month (₱234,000/month) in total earnings including commissions and monthly bonuses.

• Earn between AUD $100 - $800 (approximately ₱4,500–₱36,000) commission per deal..

• Repeat business stays with you: when a client you funded returns for more funding, you handle their next deal and earn commission again.

• Earn additional monthly performance bonuses based on KPI’s achieved.

After your two-month probation, benefits include the base salary increase, an HMO allowance, paid annual and sick leave, and access to higher bonus tiers.





WHO WE ARE



Ezy Pzy Finance is a fast growing Australian business finance company connecting business owners with a panel of non-bank lenders.

We’re growing our remote sales team and looking for consultants who combine strong closing skills with clear communication and disciplined follow-up.

Learn more: 





WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Call Australian business owners who have already expressed interest in funding.

• Understand their business, funding needs and timing.

• Qualify enquiries and guide clients through the application process.

• Explain available options clearly, handle objections and move deals towards settlement.

• Keep your pipeline organised and follow up consistently.

• Build relationships that generate repeat business.



Warm leads are provided. There is no cold prospecting or list building, but the role involves regular outbound calls and persistent follow-up.





WHO SHOULD APPLY



You have at least two years of phone-based sales experience and have personally been responsible for closing sales and achieving targets.



We particularly welcome sales experience in:



• Business lending or merchant cash advance campaigns.

• Australian or US mortgage and asset finance.

• Insurance, debt solutions or other financial products.



Successful closers from other industries are also encouraged to apply. Show us what you sold, your targets, your results and your role in winning the business.



You should be able to:



• Build trust and communicate confidently in spoken English.

• Run a discovery conversation and ask useful follow-up questions.

• Explain products clearly and handle objections professionally.

• Own your pipeline, maintain accurate records and follow through.

• Learn new products and apply coaching.



Finance processing, customer service or appointment-setting experience is useful, but you must also demonstrate personal closing experience.





TRAINING AND SUPPORT



Your first four weeks include structured product and sales training, with an initial focus on smaller loan facilities up to approximately A$30,000.

You’ll progress to larger deals as you meet quality and settlement milestones, supported by weekly one-to-one sales coaching.





SCHEDULE AND SETUP



• Monday–Friday, 6:30am–4:30pm Philippine time.

• One-hour lunch break; 45 working hours/week.

• Fully remote, with evenings free.

• Reliable computer, internet connection and backup internet/power arrangements required.





HOW TO APPLY



Incomplete applications will not be considered. Complete applications get a response within 48 hours.

Provide ALL 5 of the following:

A short video (3–5 minutes, Loom / Google Drive / unlisted YouTube link) in two parts:



Part 1 — introduce yourself, your sales experience, and the results/KPIs you achieved (numbers, not adjectives).



Part 2 — a 2-minute mock opening of a discovery call: pretend you’ve just dialled an Australian business owner from Ezy Pzy Finance — do your opening, build rapport, and start qualifying them for funding.



- Link to your resume.

- Screenshots of your DISC assessment and IQ test results (tests available at 
/testcontent).

- Screenshot of your internet speed test, provider, and PC/laptop specs.

- Your backup internet and power solutions.

- Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a Zoom interview, including a live discovery-call role-play.





If you’re a top performing sales professional and have the self drive to earn big commissions and grow in a company that is focused on long term success, then submit your application and we’ll see if we’re a good fit to work together.

title: AI-Native Software Architect — Senior Full-Stack IC
description:
Location: Remote — Philippines

Schedule: Part-time initially, with a path to full-time

Working hours: Full overlap with Los Angeles/Pacific Time working hours

Starting compensation: $7–$12 USD per hour, based on experience

Reports directly to: Founder and CEO



Executive Summary



Bellaura is seeking an experienced AI-Native Software Architect who can personally architect and ship production features at exceptional speed using tools such as Codex and Claude. This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role for someone who can translate business requirements into technical architecture, direct AI development workflows, and ensure the resulting software is secure, maintainable, tested, and production-ready. The role can expand substantially in scope, compensation, and ownership as the company grows and becomes funded.



The Opportunity



Bellaura is an early-stage technology platform for creators, creative professionals, events, collaboration, and bookings. You will work directly with a technical founder and a team that includes experienced Microsoft engineers.



Much of the application has been developed through AI-assisted engineering. We are now looking for someone with deep software-engineering experience who can dramatically increase our development velocity without sacrificing quality.



This is not a traditional architect role focused on diagrams, meetings, or managing other engineers. You will make architectural decisions and personally implement major features using AI as an engineering multiplier.



What You Will Do

Translate business and product requirements into clear technical requirements.

Architect and implement major features across the frontend, backend, and database.

Use Codex, Claude, and related tools to accelerate development significantly.

Break large initiatives into coherent, AI-executable implementation plans.

Provide AI agents with the context, constraints, patterns, and acceptance criteria needed to produce reliable code.

Run multiple agents or parallel development workflows where appropriate.

Review and correct all AI-generated code before it reaches production.

Design secure PostgreSQL schemas, authorization rules, APIs, and application flows.

Build with security, privacy, performance, feature gating, testing, observability, and safe rollout in mind.

Lead major refactors while preventing inconsistent patterns and unnecessary technical debt.

Maintain architecture documentation that helps both engineers and AI agents understand the codebase.

Diagnose difficult production issues and improve engineering standards as the platform grows.

Current Technical Direction



The current platform is directionally built around:



React and TypeScript

Vite

Supabase

PostgreSQL

Authentication, storage, and realtime functionality

Automated testing

CI/CD and production deployment workflows



Direct experience with every current technology is not required. However, you must be able to understand an existing codebase quickly, identify architectural risks, and begin shipping high-quality work without requiring extensive supervision.



Required Qualifications

At least eight years of professional software-engineering experience.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related field.

Advanced React and TypeScript experience.

Strong PostgreSQL and relational data-modeling expertise.

Experience designing production systems at meaningful scale.

Strong system-design and software-architecture judgment.

Experience providing technical leadership, setting standards, or guiding architectural decisions.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Ability to personally implement substantial production features—not only design or delegate them.

Availability to work entirely within Los Angeles/Pacific Time business hours, which will generally require overnight working hours in the Philippines.

Strong understanding of security, authorization, privacy, testing, performance, and production reliability.

AI-Native Engineering Requirements



We are not looking for someone who occasionally asks ChatGPT to generate a function.



You should be able to demonstrate experience with several of the following:



Using Codex, Claude Code, or comparable agentic development tools on real production systems.

Dividing complex features into effective prompts, tasks, and validation stages.

Supplying agents with architecture documents, coding standards, schemas, and repository context.

Managing large refactors through AI without losing consistency or introducing hidden regressions.

Detecting hallucinated APIs, insecure implementations, incorrect assumptions, and poor architectural decisions.

Coordinating multiple agents or parallel workstreams safely.

Using tests, type checking, code review, and manual validation to verify generated work.

Structuring repositories and documentation so future AI-assisted development becomes faster and more reliable.



The best candidate will view AI as a powerful execution layer while understanding that experienced engineering judgment remains essential.



Strongly Preferred Background



We strongly prefer candidates who have also worked as a:



Business Analyst

Product Manager

Technical Product Manager

Product Owner

Founder or technical co-founder

Senior engineer with substantial product ownership



Formal titles are not mandatory. What matters is your ability to take an incomplete business objective, identify missing requirements, understand the user experience, make sound tradeoffs, and convert it into a technical plan that can be implemented successfully.



Experience with Supabase, row-level security, marketplaces, social platforms, booking systems, payments, automated testing, CI/CD, or feature-flag systems is also valuable.



The Type of Engineer Who Will Succeed



You will likely succeed in this role if you:



Ship quickly without treating security or quality as optional.

Can move from an ambiguous idea to a production-ready implementation.

Make practical architectural decisions rather than overengineering.

Challenge unclear or risky requirements while still maintaining momentum.

Investigate problems independently before escalating them.

Understand where AI can accelerate development and where human review is indispensable.

Communicate tradeoffs clearly to a business-oriented founder.

Take ownership of outcomes rather than only completing assigned tickets.

Prefer building and shipping over spending excessive time in meetings.

Growth and Compensation



The position will begin part-time and can move toward full-time based on performance, product needs, and company growth.



Bellaura is currently unfunded, so the initial compensation is $7–$12 USD per hour. We want to be direct that this is below the long-term compensation expected for someone operating at this level.



For a proven performer, our current intention is to increase compensation significantly after funding, with a target of approximately $20 USD per hour, subject to funding, performance, expanded responsibilities, and a formal compensation agreement. Equity may also become available later for someone who demonstrates exceptional long-term value.



This opportunity is best suited to someone who values early ownership, direct influence over the product, and the ability to establish themselves as a critical technical leader before the company’s next stage of growth.



Selection Process



Qualified candidates may be invited to:



Interview directly with the founder.

Review and discuss a realistic system-design problem.

Demonstrate an AI-assisted development workflow.

Review flawed AI-generated code and identify risks.

Complete a short paid technical exercise.

Provide professional references.

How to Apply



Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, GitHub or portfolio links, hourly-rate expectation, availability, and answers to the following three questions. Keep each answer concise and specific.



1. Describe the most substantial production feature or refactor you have completed using Codex, Claude, or another AI development system.



What were you building, how did you structure the work for AI, what context did you provide, and how did you verify the resulting code? Explain what you personally architected, reviewed, corrected, and shipped. Include links, diagrams, screenshots, or a short demonstration when available.



2. How would you architect a feature-gated event-ticketing system with promoter attribution?



Assume users can purchase tickets, promoters receive trackable links, hosts can approve attendees, rejected attendees may require refunds, and access must be protected by user roles.



Briefly describe:



The core PostgreSQL entities and relationships.

Authorization and privacy controls.

How you would prevent duplicate purchases or attribution errors.

The three most important failure cases.

Your testing and rollout strategy.



We are evaluating your reasoning, prioritization, and ability to translate business behavior into a reliable technical design—not the length of your answer.



3. Describe a time you converted an ambiguous business requirement into a successful production system.



What was initially unclear? What questions did you ask? Which technical and product tradeoffs did you make? What did you personally implement, and what measurable result did the finished system produce?

title: TikTok Ops Specialist
description:
We're hiring a TikTok Operator to run and grow our U.S. TikTok Shop. This isn't a content or social media job — it's a business role. You'll own the whole channel: TikTok Shop, creators/affiliates, content, ads, livestreams, and the numbers behind all of it.



We want a builder! Someone who either launched a TikTok Shop from zero and made it succeed, or took over a shop that wasn't performing and turned it around. It needs to be *their* win — not a channel they just helped run while someone else called the shots.



You'll start hands-on, with room to build and lead a team as the channel grows.

---





JOB SPECIFICATIONS



[TikTok Business & Profitability]

- Understands how to grow TikTok sales while protecting margin, not just chasing GMV

- Good with numbers — can tell what's working, what's not, and what to scale or stop



[TikTok Shop Operations]

- Knows how TikTok Shop works — listings, pricing, promos, bundles, discount codes, store health



[Creators & Affiliates]

- Experience finding, recruiting, and managing TikTok creators and affiliates



[Content, Advertising & Livestream]

- Can guide short-form content strategy based on what performs well

- Familiar with TikTok Ads/Spark Ads and livestream operations



[Analytics & Reporting]

- Comfortable pulling together weekly performance updates and explaining the "why" behind the numbers



[Systems & Team Building]

- Can build simple SOPs/processes so the work runs smoothly as the team grows

- Open to eventually helping hire and manage a small supporting team





DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run the TikTok channel and grow its sales for the U.S. market

- Manage the TikTok Shop — product listings, pricing, promos, and store health

- Find, recruit, and manage TikTok creators and affiliates to promote products

- Plan and guide short-form video content based on what performs well

- Handle or oversee TikTok ads and livestreams

- Give weekly updates on sales, ads, creators, and content performance

- Create simple processes so the work can run smoothly as the team grows

- Strong English communication skills, written and verbal

- Can work independently, solve problems, and take full ownership of results





NON-NEGOTIABLES



- Based within Luzon, and willing to travel to NCR whenever the CEO is in Manila to check in with the team

- Was the main driver — not just a helper — behind a TikTok Shop's growth or launch. This means one of:

    [1] Launched a TikTok Shop from scratch and built it into a success (or at least got it to a strong state before leaving the company/client), or...

    [2] Took over a TikTok Shop with little to no traction (low sales/GMV) and turned it around

- Can clearly explain *their own* strategy and decisions behind that growth — not just point to results the shop achieved under someone else's plan

- Strong track record of driving measurable sales growth and improving overall TikTok channel performance

- Strong understanding of the TikTok Shop ecosystem and its key sales/growth drivers





NICE TO HAVE



- Background in health, wellness, beauty, personal care, supplements, medical products, sports, or other regulated consumer categories

- Experience managing TikTok at significant sales/GMV scale, or across multiple brands/shops

- Experience building or leading a TikTok/e-commerce team, or managing large creator networks

- Direct experience working with TikTok account managers or platform reps

- Experience managing TikTok alongside Amazon or other major e-commerce channels

title: Customer Acquisition VA | TikTok Research + Buyer Conversations
description:

“What do I eat?”



I’m looking for one reliable VA to help us find people online who are already asking questions like this and genuinely help them.



This is NOT cold calling.



This is NOT mass DMing.



This is NOT copy-and-paste spam.



Your job is simple:



Find real buyer questions → understand what they need → help them → save what we learn → turn good questions into content opportunities.



You will receive a detailed visual playbook showing you:



• exactly where to search

• exact search phrases to use

• what a valuable buyer comment looks like

• what comments to skip

• how to respond naturally

• when to mention our free resource

• when NOT to promote anything

• how to use ChatGPT correctly

• how to turn buyer questions into content ideas

• what numbers to track

• exactly when your work for the day is finished

You DO need to be:



• reliable

• comfortable using TikTok and social media

• good at following instructions

• able to write simple conversational English

• curious about what people actually want

Complete this small task:

GOLD FOUND



so I know you read the instructions.

title: Property Accountant--AppFolio
description:
# Property Accountant — AppFolio | Full-Time, Remote | US$1,200–$1,600/Month



**Location:** Philippines — work from home

**Hours:** 40 hours per week

**Schedule:** Four hours of daily overlap with U.S. Pacific business hours; remaining hours on an agreed schedule

**Compensation:** US$1,200–$1,600 per month, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated skills



## About Amped Kitchens



Amped Kitchens builds, owns, and operates commercial kitchen buildings in Los Angeles and Chicago. Our clients include packaged-food brands (including several Filipino-owned brands), restaurant groups, and meal subscription companies that rely on us for the space and infrastructure to produce at scale.



We operate three properties and several related entities. We value accurate work, clear communication, follow-through, and people who spot and fix problems .



Learn more at 
.



## About the Role



We’re looking for an experienced Property Accountant with strong, hands-on AppFolio skills to manage daily accounting, maintain accurate financial records, and prepare monthly closes under our CFO’s supervision.



You will work closely with our onsite Tenant Coordinators, who handle client administration, invoice intake, and move-in/move-out coordination. Your responsibility is to keep the accounting accurate, resolve discrepancies, and make sure financial tasks reach completion.



You should be comfortable investigating an unfamiliar balance, questioning an unsupported transaction, and following up for missing information. We want someone who helps catch and prevent problems.



Our current workload includes fewer than 1,000 transactions and up to 250 vendor bills per month, with up to 10 bank and credit card accounts.



## What You’ll Do



**Accounts payable and payments**



* Review and process bills in AppFolio, confirming the correct entity, property, account, accounting period, supporting documents, and approvals.

* Handle shared expenses and allocations across entities and properties.

* Identify duplicate invoices, reconcile vendor statements and credits, and resolve discrepancies.

* Prepare scheduled payment runs for approval and process authorized payments.

* Track overdue or blocked invoices and give the team reliable information about payment status.



**Client billing and accounts receivable**



* Review recurring charges for completeness and accuracy, including rent, utilities, Facility Cost, storage, parking, escalations, and approved concessions.

* Work with Tenant Coordinators to resolve billing errors and discrepancies between AppFolio records and approved lease terms.

* Review payment applications and resolve unapplied, returned, or incorrectly posted receipts.

* Maintain accurate AR aging, reconcile receivables to the general ledger, and coordinate collection follow-up with Tenant Coordinators.

* Maintain accurate security-deposit accounting and process authorized refunds using the Tenant Coordinator’s completed disposition.



**Monthly close and financial reporting**



* Maintain accrual-basis accounting records in AppFolio.

* Reconcile bank, credit card, balance sheet, and intercompany accounts.

* Prepare accruals, adjusting entries, and supporting schedules for prepaid expenses, loans, fixed assets, capital improvements, and other assigned accounts.

* Prepare monthly financial statements and explain significant changes or budget variances.

* Prepare the monthly close package for CFO review by the 10th calendar day, following an agreed close calendar.

* Request missing information promptly and flag issues that could affect reporting accuracy or deadlines.

* Prepare supporting information for the outside CPA, year-end reporting, and lender requests.



**Payroll accounting and cash monitoring**



* Record and reconcile payroll processed through ADP, including allocations across entities and properties.

* Monitor cash balances and upcoming payment obligations.

* Flag funding needs early and prepare proposed intercompany transfers for approval.



**Communication and process improvement**



* Resolve accounting questions from Tenant Coordinators, clients, and vendors, keeping the appropriate team members informed.

* Maintain clear supporting records and notes in AppFolio.

* Document recurring accounting procedures and help improve inefficient or unclear workflows.

* Identify recurring errors and help the team prevent them.



## What We’re Looking For



* At least three years of relevant accounting experience, including responsibility for monthly closes.

* **Direct AppFolio accounting experience is required**, including reconciliations, tenant ledgers, AP/AR, and journal entries.

* Experience supporting U.S. property accounting; commercial real estate experience is strongly preferred.

* Strong understanding of accrual accounting and multi-entity/intercompany transactions.

* Strong Excel skills for reconciliations, allocations, and analysis.

* Clear written and spoken English, including the ability to explain an accounting issue to someone outside Accounting.

* Reliable follow-through, sound judgment, and willingness to ask questions when something does not look right.

* Reliable internet, a suitable workspace, and a practical backup plan for connectivity or power interruptions.



An accounting degree or equivalent professional experience is preferred. CPA credentials and ADP experience are helpful but not required.



## Working Schedule



You will work 40 hours per week, with four consistent hours each business day overlapping with **9 a.m.–5 p.m. U.S. Pacific Time, Monday–Friday**. We will agree on the exact overlap and remaining working hours before you start.



For example, a 1–5 p.m. Pacific overlap corresponds to:



* **4–8 a.m. Philippine time, Tuesday–Saturday**, during U.S. daylight saving time.

* **5–9 a.m. Philippine time, Tuesday–Saturday**, during U.S. standard time.



## What You Can Expect



* A long-term, full-time remote role supporting one operating business.

* Direct access to the CFO for accounting guidance and review.

* Collaboration with onsite teams who provide operational information and support.

* Flexibility outside the agreed overlap hours.

* Meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to improve how the accounting function works.



## How to Apply



Please apply through this posting with your résumé and brief answers to these questions:



1. How long have you used AppFolio, and which accounting tasks have you personally performed?

2. Which parts of month-end close have you owned, and who reviewed your work?

3. Describe an accounting error you discovered. How did you investigate and resolve it?

4. What four-hour Pacific overlap can you consistently work, when could you start, and what compensation are you seeking within the posted range?



Shortlisted candidates will complete an interview and a short, paid accounting exercise using fictional records. We will request professional references from finalists.

title: Operations, Sourcing & Logistics Assistant
description:
Company: MNJ Trading

Location: Remote

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Working hours: 8:00AM-12NN MANILA TIME



About MNJ Trading



MNJ Trading is an import and export company serving customers throughout the South Pacific region. Our customers operate primarily in the hospitality, industrial, and commercial sectors.



We help customers source suitable products, identify competitive suppliers, prepare quotations, coordinate orders, and arrange delivery to their destination.



About the Role



We are looking for a practical, organized, and detail-oriented Operations, Sourcing & Logistics Assistant.



This is not a role based only on writing
s or speaking confidently. You will be expected to research products, compare suppliers, check specifications, calculate shipping volumes, prepare accurate quotations, follow up on orders, and keep information properly organized.



Our selection process includes a practical work assessment based on the actual responsibilities of the role.



Main Responsibilities:

- Research products based on customer requirements.

- Find and compare suitable suppliers.

- Verify product specifications, pricing, availability, MOQ, lead time, warranty, and delivery conditions.

- Request missing information from suppliers.

- Prepare supplier comparison sheets.

- Calculate carton quantities, weights, dimensions, CBM, and estimated shipping costs.

- Prepare accurate customer quotations.

- Coordinate orders with suppliers, warehouses, freight forwarders, and customers.

- Monitor order and shipment progress.

- Maintain organized records, spreadsheets, invoices, packing lists, and shipping documents.

- Identify missing or conflicting information before it becomes a problem.

- Provide clear updates to management and customers.

- Manage several requests according to urgency and commercial importance.



What Good Performance Looks Like



A successful team member:

- Checks details instead of making unsupported assumptions.

- Understands the difference between the lowest price and the best commercial option.

- Can identify when a product does not fully meet the customer’s requirements.

- Uses spreadsheet formulas correctly.

- Keeps source links, calculations, and records easy to verify.

- Communicates delays and problems early.

- Follows instructions and meets deadlines.

- Takes ownership of tasks through completion.

- Asks specific questions when information is missing.

- Produces accurate work without requiring constant supervision.



Required Skills

- Strong online product and supplier research skills.

- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

- Ability to compare prices and commercial terms.

- Confidence working with quantities, dimensions, weights, and CBM.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Clear written English.

- Ability to organize files and information.

- Good judgment when handling incomplete or conflicting information.

- Reliable internet connection and ability to work independently.



Experience in procurement, sourcing, logistics, import/export, hospitality supplies, industrial supplies, or quotation preparation is an advantage.



Application Process



The process consists of:

- Initial application review

- MNJ Trading Practical Work Assessment 

- A short interview and live work verification

- Reference checks, if applicable.



Generic cover letters will not receive additional points. We are more interested in clear evidence of how you work.



How to Apply



Please submit:

- Brief Introduction why you're best fit for this role

- One redacted example of a supplier comparison, quotation, logistics spreadsheet, or similar document you personally prepared.



Your answers to the questions below.

1. Describe one product you previously sourced. What information did you verify before recommending a supplier?

2. Tell us about a mistake or discrepancy you found in an invoice, quotation, order, or shipping document. What did you do?

3. If a supplier provides a low price but does not confirm the required specifications, how would you handle it?



Please use the subject line:

Application – Operations Assistant – [Your Full Name]



Applications that progress to the next stage will receive the practical assessment instructions.

Company is seeking a detail-oriented, culturally fluent Bilingual Administration & Client Liaison Coordinator to strengthen the administrative backbone of the business while opening a dedicated channel of communication with our growing base of Mandarin-speaking guests, inbound tour partners, and travel agents. This is a genuinely varied administrative role: the majority of your week will be spent on core office administration, records management, and booking/CRM support, with a meaningful portion dedicated to Mandarin-English guest liaison, translation of guest-facing materials, and coordination with Chinese-market travel trade contacts.



This role suits a candidate who is equally comfortable maintaining a tidy filing system and greeting a Mandarin-speaking guest with warmth and confidence — someone who takes pride in accuracy, communicates clearly across two languages and cultures, and is energised by variety rather than overwhelmed by it. Prior exposure to aviation, tourism, or inbound travel businesses is a strong advantage, as elements of this role (SA
 awareness, guest safety briefings, pilot logistics) are specific to the industry.



Key Duties & Responsibilities

1. General Administration & Records (~35% of role — Primary Focus)

, phone, and messaging channels.

Required Education

Required Traits

● Culturally Fluent Communicator: Able to move naturally between English and Mandarin business communication styles, representing Company professionally to guests and partners from both cultures.

title: Creator Outreach Specialist - Message, Follow Up and Book Calls
description:
VIXA is a new AI dating clarity app for women. We are building our creator program from the ground up and need a Creator Outreach Specialist to help us grow it.



What you will do:

- Send personalized opening messages to verified content creators (no copy paste templates, every message needs at least 1 specific detail about that creator)

- Run the follow up sequence until you get a reply

- Book calls with creators who are interested

- Get creators to join our 
 server and stay active there

- Help creators finish their first paid trial video



How to message creators (this is how we expect every message to look):

1. Mention 1 real detail about that creator. Example: a recent video they posted, their niche, or their follower count. No generic compliments.

2. State 1 clear offer in a single sentence. Example: "$1 per 1,000 views, up to $1,000 per video."

3. End with 1 clear next step. Example: "Want me to send you the details and a link to join?" Never end with a vague line like "let me know."

4. Add 1 line of proof. Example: "VIXA is a real app, live in the App Store."

5. Keep it short. A few sentences, not a long paragraph. 1 link maximum.

6. If they do not reply in 48 to 72 hours, send 1 short follow up. If still no reply after that, send 1 final short message and move on.

7. Never sound desperate or pushy. Sound like a professional offering a real paid opportunity.



You can use Claude AI or ChatGPT to help you draft your messages, but every message must still be personalized and unique.



Pay:

- $5.00 to $8.00 per hour to start

- $2.00 to $3.00 bonus for every creator who replies

- $5.00 to $10.00 bonus for every creator who joins our 
 server

- $15.00 to $25.00 bonus for every creator who finishes their first paid trial video

- Once you get 5 or more creators through the full process, your hourly rate goes up to $10.00 or more



Hours: 10 hours per week to start, moving up to 20 to 25 hours per week for strong performers. Goal: reach out to 20 to 30 new creators every week.



How we treat the people who work with us: on time pay, clear standards, early feedback, and a raise as you prove yourself.



To apply: put the word VELA somewhere in your application so we know you read this whole post. We also want a short video, 2 to 3 minutes, where you role play the first few minutes of a message conversation with a creator (not a self introduction).



Looking for: strong English, a warm and inviting personality, and experience with social media, influencer marketing, lead generation, or virtual assistance.

description:
Join a high-output creative team running fast-growing social channels for U.S.-based expert and media brands. Your job is simple to define and hard to do: own the content calendar, own the numbers, and turn attention into measurable growth for our clients.



We specialize in transforming social feeds into growth engines, consistently driving 50%+ reach increases in the first 90 days. If you love taking full ownership, moving fast, and being judged by results, you’ll fit here.

About This Role

We’re looking for a performance-driven Social Media Marketing Manager who understands U.S. culture and can manage full channels end to end.

You will:

, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.

* Make decisions from data, not vibes.

* Communicate clearly with founders, clients, and teammates in real time.

You’ve already grown channels before and can prove it with screenshots, dashboards, and clear before/after metrics.



Key Responsibilities

Content & Channel Ownership

* Build and maintain daily content calendars for assigned clients (typically 3-6 posts per platform per day).

* Turn raw footage, ideas, and existing assets into clear briefs for editors and designers.

Strategy & Analytics

* Set clear growth targets per account (reach, views, subscribers/followers, CTR, watch time).

* Track and report weekly performance to the internal team and clients.

* Identify winners and losers, then update hooks, thumbnails, titles, and topics accordingly.

* Stay current on cultural trends and platform changes, especially for American audiences.

Client & Team Communication

* Give clients simple, honest updates: what we did, what happened, what we’re doing next.

* Translate client feedback into clear tasks for editors/designers.

* Work in a fast-paced, feedback-heavy environment without dropping the ball.



Expected Results (How You’ll Be Measured)

* Growth: 50%+ account-wide reach/views increase within the first 90 days for new clients.

* Consistency: 95%+ on-time posting rate against agreed content calendar.

* Engagement: Rising engagement rates and watch time across key platforms.

* Execution: Clear weekly reports and strategic recommendations for every account you manage.



Requirements

Experience & Skills

* 3+ years managing social media channels with proven growth (YouTube and Instagram required).

* Experience in an agency or multi-brand environment strongly preferred.

* Deep understanding of U.S. audience behavior, storytelling, pacing, and platform nuances.

Technical

* Comfortable editing and adjusting short-form videos (CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar).

* Strong eye for hooks, thumbnails, titles, and short-form trends.

* Proficiency with Canva/Photoshop and social scheduling/analytics tools.

Communication & Work Style

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Fast, clear communication (primarily WhatsApp and Slack).

* Ability to work aligned with New York time zone.

* Reliable high-speed internet.

* Comfortable with direct feedback, changing priorities, and high standards.



Portfolio Requirements

* Links to social accounts you’ve managed with before/after growth metrics.

* Short-form video examples (Reels/Shorts/TikToks) aligned with current trends.

* Any case studies or breakdowns of how you improved a channel.



What We Offer

* Full-time role with clear advancement paths as we grow.

* Work with a sharp, global creative and operations team.

* Direct line of sight from your work to client revenue and impact.

* Access to systems, training, and playbooks on cutting-edge content and monetization.



If you want a role where you’re judged by output and growth, not meetings and politics, this is it.

This is not a narrowly defined administrative position. We want someone who can begin with an unclear objective, determine what needs to happen, and turn it into an organized, repeatable process.



For the right person, this position could grow into an Operations Manager or another leadership role.

s, client communications, and internal documentation

- Are exceptionally resourceful and good at figuring things out

- Think critically instead of waiting for detailed instructions

- Can bring structure to incomplete or ambiguous projects

- Communicate clearly in excellent written and spoken English

- Are comfortable switching between analytical, administrative, creative, and commercial work

- Understand both execution and process improvement

- Can prioritize effectively when several things need attention

- Follow through reliably and close open loops

This is not an entry-level role. We're looking for someone who has worked within CPG, FMCG, food, or a similar product-based business and understands the level of accuracy required when working with large retailers, distributors, 3PLs, and supply chain partners. A CPG or consumer product background is essential — understanding the mindset and operational requirements of this type of product environment is important to us. You should be comfortable taking a project or operational requirement, understanding what needs to happen, gathering the necessary information, and driving it through to completion with minimal hand-holding.

Schedule: Part-time to start (approximately 20 hours per week), with strong potential to progress into a full-time role

Opportunity: Long-term position working with an international business operating across the US, Europe, and Asia

Compensation: (please confirm rate)

1. Product Master Data Management



Manage and maintain accurate product master data including SKUs, UPCs/GTINs, barcodes, case configurations, dimensions, weights, ingredients, and other product specifications

Review product and packaging information for accuracy, including ingredient information and multilingual requirements

Maintain organized and accurate product information across internal databases, retailer portals, and operational documents

Maintain clear file structures, documentation, and internal systems so information can be easily accessed and updated



2. Retailer Onboarding & Account Administration



Complete retailer new vendor, new item, and product setup forms accurately and on time

Support onboarding and ongoing administration for major US and European retail accounts

Review retailer requirements and ensure all necessary operational documentation is completed correctly

Support the completion of retailer-specific compliance forms, portals, templates, and documentation



3. ERP & EDI Support



Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of the company's ERP system

Assist with EDI setup and coordination, working with external EDI partners, retailers, and internal stakeholders

Prepare and organize the data required for ERP migration, integration, and system setup



4. Logistics & Supply Chain Documentation



Help manage product, logistics, and supply chain documentation for US import and 3PL operations

Coordinate information between suppliers, factories, 3PLs, retail partners, and internal stakeholders

Please confirm your English level (C2) and your confidence in both written and spoken English.

title: YouTube Video Editor | Long-Form, Travel & Product Content | 20 Hrs/Week
description:
I’m looking for a part-time video editor to help me grow my YouTube channels and Amazon Influencer storefront.



I create a lot of content including product reviews and comparisons, tutorials, travel videos, RV and lifestyle content, and Amazon shoppable videos. I’ve reached the point where I simply can’t edit it all myself.



But I’m not just looking for someone to hand footage to.



**I’m looking for a creative collaboration partner who wants to grow with me.**



This will start at approximately **20 hours per week**, with the potential to grow into a full-time role as my channels and business grow.



///What I’m Looking For:



You should have video editing experience and a good understanding of pacing, storytelling, and what keeps people watching.



**Final Cut Pro is preferred**, but I’m more interested in finding the right person than someone who checks every technical box.



Strong English comprehension and communication are important. My videos are conversational and include humor and sarcasm, so you need to understand not only what I’m saying, but the tone behind it.



Most importantly, **I want you to have an opinion.**



If a section is boring, tell me. If I’m talking too long, cut it. If you think my idea isn’t going to work, say so. If you see a better way to tell the story, I want to hear it.



I’ll make the final decisions, but I’m not looking for someone who just says yes and follows instructions. I want someone who eventually knows my content well enough to help make it better.



You don’t need to know everything on day one. I’m happy to teach you my workflow and editing preferences. I’m looking for someone dependable, curious, creative, willing to learn, and interested in building something long-term.



///What You’ll Be Editing



The work will include a mix of:



Product reviews and comparisons

Tutorials and how-to videos

Travel videos and destination guides

RV and lifestyle content

Vlogs

Amazon Influencer and shoppable videos



Some projects will be pretty straightforward. Others will involve going through a lot of footage and figuring out the best way to tell the story.



**To Apply**



Please send me:



1. A short introduction and a little about who you are and your editing experience

2. Links to 2 or 3 videos you personally edited

3. What editing software you use

4. Your desired hourly rate

5. How many hours per week you currently have available



Then watch this video:



**
**



Briefly tell me what you think worked well and what you would have done differently as the editor.

You can comment on pacing, structure, cuts, B-roll, storytelling, or anything else you notice. There is no correct answer. I want to see how you think, and I genuinely want you to be willing to disagree with me.



**Start your application with the word PINEAPPLE so I know you actually read the entire posting.**



I’m hoping to find someone who starts as my editor but eventually becomes an important creative partner in growing my YouTube channels, Amazon storefront, and whatever we build next.
