title: Personal & Executive Assistant / Life Operations & Accountability Partner
description:
## About the Role



I am looking for a highly organized, proactive, trustworthy, and confident Personal & Executive Assistant who can help me manage my personal life, education, administrative responsibilities, and multiple businesses.



This is **not a traditional Virtual Assistant position** where you wait every morning for me to give you a list of tasks.



I need someone who can gradually become my organizational “second brain”: understand what is happening across my life, keep track of unfinished responsibilities, prepare things before I need them, organize information, follow up with me, and actively help me stay focused.



I am a mother to a young daughter whom I absolutely adore, and she naturally wants a lot of my attention throughout the day. I do not plan to hire a nanny due to personal reasons.



Instead, I am looking for someone who can help me organize my work and responsibilities around being a very involved mother.



I am also very aware that I have taken on a lot this year. I do not need someone to tell me that I am busy — I need someone who can help me turn that workload into something organized and manageable.



Some days you may organize
s and documents. Another day you may prepare a grocery list, update an expense tracker, research flights, prepare instructions for an employee, attend a client meeting, organize employment/immigration records, help me organize my laptop, or simply stay on Zoom with me while I finish something important that I have been postponing.



This role requires flexibility, initiative, discretion, excellent organization, and good judgment.



## Daily Organization & Accountability



A major part of your job will be helping me determine what actually needs my attention.



You may:



* Maintain one master task system across my personal life, education, and businesses

* Prepare my priorities for the day

* Prepare the following day's plan

* Review upcoming deadlines and commitments

* Maintain my calendar

* Schedule and reschedule appointments

* Protect important focus/work blocks

* Keep track of unfinished tasks

* Maintain follow-up and “waiting for” lists

* Break overwhelming projects into smaller actions

* Keep non-urgent ideas in a backlog

* Remind me about important responsibilities

* Follow up when something has not been completed

* Conduct weekly planning/reset sessions with me

* Adjust plans when real life changes unexpectedly



I specifically want someone who is comfortable **holding me accountable**.



If we agreed that I need to spend the next 90 minutes working on something important and I become distracted by something less important, I want you to respectfully redirect me.



I do not need another person waiting for me to tell them what to do.



I want someone who eventually understands my priorities well enough that I can ask:



**“What should I be working on right now?”**



and you can help me answer that.



## Zoom Accountability / “Do It With Me” Sessions



This is an important and somewhat unusual part of the position.



There will be times when I need you to join me on Zoom while I work.



For example:



* Stay on Zoom while I work on my master's degree

* Help keep me focused during a 60–90 minute work session

* Sit with me while I complete business administration

* Work through a new business system/process alongside me

* Help me complete paperwork I have postponed

* Help me process and organize my inbox

* Screen-share while we organize files on my laptop

* Sit with me while I work through client/business processes

* Take notes while I work

* Capture action items that come up during the session

* Keep me from unnecessarily switching between tasks

* Record exactly where we stopped and what needs to happen next



Sometimes your responsibility may simply be:



**“We said we were finishing this today. Let's finish it before moving to something else.”**



You will not complete my academic work for me. I remain responsible for my own academic work.



Your role is accountability, organization, preparation, and helping me actually complete the things I have d
 are important.



## Voice-Based Productivity



I would also like help learning how to use **voice and dictation to work more efficiently**.



Typing can sometimes slow me down significantly, so I want to explore practical ways to use my voice for more of my work while still personally completing and reviewing everything that requires me.



You may help me:



* Learn and set up speech-to-text/dictation tools

* Learn how to work efficiently using voice instead of typing everything

* Help me test voice-based workflows while we are together on Zoom

* Find ways for me to dictate my own thoughts for graduate-school work and then personally review, edit, verify, cite, and finalize them

* Use dictation to prepare
s and business communications faster

* Use voice when working on documents, planning, brainstorming, and other appropriate tasks

* Research tools or workflows that could reduce the amount of manual typing I need to do

* Help me practice and improve the workflow until it actually saves me time



You do not need to already be an expert in voice technology. I mainly need someone who is comfortable researching solutions, testing them with me, and helping me find a system that works.



##
 & Communication Management



I need significant help reducing the amount of time I spend processing
 and routine communications.



You may:



* Organize personal and business inboxes

* Create and maintain labels/folders

* Identify urgent messages

* Archive unnecessary messages

* Flag messages requiring my attention

* Draft responses

* Send routine approved communications when authorized

* Track unanswered
s

* Follow up when necessary

* Keep track of people/companies we are waiting to hear from

* Summarize long
 conversations

* Organize attachments

* Prepare documents needed for responses

* Maintain reusable communication templates

* Maintain a “Needs My Decision” category so I can review important items together rather than constantly being interrupted



The goal is for me to spend significantly less time processing routine communication myself.



## Business Operations



I manage multiple business activities and already have/will have other team members with their own specific responsibilities.



**You are not replacing those employees.**



Your role is to support me across everything and help coordinate the administrative and executive side of the businesses.



This may include:



* Maintain high-level business task lists

* Prepare documents

* Create SOPs

* Create employee instructions

* Prepare training materials

* Prepare “Golden Rules” documents

* Create checklists

* Maintain company files

* Organize business calendars

* Prepare meeting agendas

* Attend appropriate meetings

* Take meeting notes

* Convert meetings into actionable tasks

* Follow up after meetings

* Track deliverables

* Prepare client files

* Maintain CRM information

* Track missing client documents

* Prepare routine client follow-ups

* Schedule client calls

* Attend appropriate client meetings with me

* Eventually handle appropriate routine meetings independently

* Organize contracts and company records

* Research software, vendors, and services

* Maintain subscriptions and renewal dates

* Coordinate administrative matters with other team members

* Collect questions from team members that actually require my decision

* Help prevent routine questions from interrupting me throughout the day



## Employee Support & Documentation



One of your responsibilities will be helping me turn my ideas and verbal explanations into organized materials for other team members.



For example, I may explain how I want something handled and ask you to turn that information into:



* A “Golden Rules” document

* SOP

* Checklist

* Training document

* Daily workflow

* Client communication guidelines

* Escalation rules

* Quality-control checklist

* Reporting template

* FAQ

* Onboarding document

* First-week schedule

* Employee reference document



You may also help organize materials and instructions needed by team members before they begin their work.



A simple principle for this position is:



**If I have to explain something repeatedly, we should document it.**



I want you to help turn knowledge that currently exists in my head into organized systems that other people can follow.



## Client & Business Process Support



Sometimes I will need you to learn a business process alongside me.



Initially, we may sit together on Zoom while I learn and work through the process.



You may:



* Observe and understand the workflow

* Take detailed notes

* Create an SOP from what we learn

* Create checklists

* Organize client information

* Update CRM records

* Prepare client files

* Track missing documents

* Prepare follow-up communications

* Schedule client calls

* Attend appropriate client meetings with me

* Take meeting notes

* Record meeting outcomes

* Track next steps

* Maintain pipeline information

* Track deal progress

* Track revenue/commissions

* Prepare information before client meetings

* Prepare things requiring my review or approval

* Handle appropriate routine client coordination



As you become familiar with a process, I would like you to gradually take ownership of appropriate administrative portions rather than requiring me to continue doing everything.



Important business, legal, financial, contractual, or other decisions that require me will remain my responsibility.



## Immigration & Employment Record Organization



I am an international graduate working in the United States, so I have important employment and immigration-related administrative records that must remain extremely organized.



This is **administrative support only. You are not expected to provide immigration or legal advice.**



You may help me:



* Maintain my employment records

* Maintain employment dates and hours

* Transfer employment information into the spreadsheet/tracker I am working with

* Keep my OPT employment documentation organized

* Organize relevant GitHub records/evidence when needed

* Organize contracts and offer letters

* Maintain supporting employment documents

* Save copies of submitted information

* Track administrative deadlines

* Prepare information I need before completing a reporting process

* Maintain chronological records

* Organize questions I need to ask my university or an immigration professional

* Draft administrative
s for my review

* Follow up on unanswered administrative
s

* Maintain an organized immigration/employment folder

* Help make sure required records are not lost across
s, downloads, folders, and different systems



I will personally make immigration decisions and complete/sign any certifications, attestations, or submissions that require me.



Your responsibility is organization, documentation, preparation, tracking, and follow-up.



## Education & Professional Programs



I am completing graduate-level education and professional programs while managing everything else.



You may:



* Maintain deadlines

* Track outstanding assignments/projects

* Maintain thesis milestones

* Organize course files

* Prepare materials before work sessions

* Maintain program calendars

* Schedule accountability sessions

* Join me on Zoom while I work

* Track progress

* Record where I stopped

* Prepare the next session

* Organize administrative correspondence

* Remind me about sessions/events I need to attend

* Help prevent business administration from constantly pushing education to the bottom of my priorities



Again, you will **not do my academic work for me**.



Your responsibility is helping me organize it, prepare for it, protect time for it, and actually sit down and complete it myself.



## Expense, Revenue & Financial Organization



I want consistent financial organization across my personal life and businesses.



You may:



* Record expenses

* Record revenue

* Categorize transactions

* Organize receipts

* Track recurring expenses

* Track contractor payments

* Track software costs

* Track subscriptions

* Track upcoming bills

* Maintain budgets

* Maintain basic cash-flow trackers

* Track business revenue vs. expenses

* Track commissions and bonuses

* Prepare weekly financial summaries

* Prepare monthly expense/revenue summaries

* Flag unusual or unnecessary recurring expenses

* Organize records for accounting/tax preparation



This is administrative bookkeeping support, not professional accounting, tax, or financial advice.



## Personal & Household Organization



This position also includes ordinary life administration.



You may:



* Prepare grocery lists

* Maintain household shopping lists

* Research products

* Compare prices

* Prepare online shopping carts for my approval

* Track household supplies

* Track packages

* Track return deadlines

* Prepare return instructions

* Follow up on refunds

* Maintain errands lists

* Organize errands efficiently

* Research cleaners or other household services

* Schedule services and appointments

* Maintain personal subscriptions

* Organize personal paperwork

* Help me remember things that need to be purchased, returned, scheduled, or completed

* Research things I simply do not have time to research myself



## Family Organization



My daughter is an extremely important part of my life.



She is young, wants to be with me a lot, and I love spending that time with her.



I am **not hiring a nanny**, and I am not looking for someone to take over childcare.



Instead, I need help reducing the administrative workload surrounding my life so that I can better manage my responsibilities while still being present with my daughter.



You may help with things such as:



* Research age-appropriate activities

* Prepare weekly activity/play ideas

* Research local activities/classes

* Research family-friendly outings

* Research toys, books, clothing, or supplies

* Prepare shopping lists

* Track things we need

* Help track clothing/supply needs

* Prepare packing lists

* Organize family documents

* Maintain appointment reminders

* Organize questions I want to ask at appointments

* Prepare travel-with-a-child checklists

* Help research family-friendly travel and activities



Parenting, childcare, health, medical, and developmental decisions remain completely with me and the appropriate professionals.



## Travel Planning



When travel is needed, you may help research and prepare the trip.



For example:



* Research round-trip flights

* Compare prices and departure times

* Research hotels

* Compare neighborhoods/locations

* Research transportation

* Research rental cars when necessary

* Research activities

* Research restaurants

* Research family-friendly places

* Prepare itinerary options

* Estimate trip costs

* Review baggage policies

* Review cancellation policies

* Prepare packing lists

* Organize reservation information

* Maintain travel-document checklists



I prefer **3–5 well-researched options instead of 30 random links**.



Your job is to reduce the amount of research I personally need to do.



## Digital & File Organization



I need help creating and maintaining an organized digital environment.



This may include:



* Organizing laptop files through screen sharing

* Cleaning and organizing Desktop and Downloads

* Organizing Google Drive

* Creating logical folder structures

* Renaming files consistently

* Organizing screenshots

* Organizing business documents

* Organizing academic documents

* Organizing personal records

* Archiving old materials

* Maintaining consistent naming conventions

* Making important information easy to find



I may literally sit with you on Zoom, share my screen, and work through the initial organization together.



Once we establish a system, I want your help maintaining it.



## Research



You should be comfortable receiving requests such as:



“Find three companies that can translate this document.”



“Research round-trip flights for these dates.”



“Compare these software options.”



“Find activities I can do with my daughter.”



“Research this business service.”



“Compare these products.”



“Find someone who can provide this service.”



Do the research, verify important information, summarize it clearly, and give me a small number of useful options.



I do not want to receive dozens of links that I then have to research myself.



## Calls, Appointments & Administrative Follow-Up



You may also help with:



* Calling customer service

* Requesting quotes

* Following up on refunds

* Following up with vendors

* Scheduling appointments

* Rescheduling appointments

* Confirming appointments

* Researching service providers

* Communicating with translators or other providers

* Handling routine software-support issues

* Following up on unresolved administrative problems

* Waiting on hold when appropriate

* Preparing information I need before a call



## Decision Management



One of the biggest ways you can help me is by reducing constant interruptions.



Instead of asking me questions individually throughout the entire day, I would like you to maintain a **“Needs My Decision”** list.



Whenever possible, research and prepare the information first.



For example, instead of:



“Which one should I choose?”



I would prefer:



“I researched the options. These are the three realistic choices, their costs, advantages, and disadvantages. I need your decision on which one to proceed with.”



We can then batch these decisions together.



## Weekly Organization



I would like us to have a regular weekly review.



We may review:



* What was completed

* What remains unfinished

* Upcoming deadlines

* Education progress

* Business priorities

* Employee/team needs

* Client matters

* Employment/immigration administration

* Expenses and revenue

* Upcoming payments

* Appointments

* Household needs

* Returns/refunds

* Travel

* Family activities

* Important documents

* Anything that has been postponed for too long



The purpose is to make sure that nothing important quietly disappears because something newer became urgent.



## What I Am Looking For



The right person is:



* Extremely organized

* Proactive

* Reliable

* Trustworthy and discreet

* Patient

* Confident

* Excellent at following up

* Comfortable working independently

* Comfortable working closely with one person

* Comfortable joining Zoom regularly

* Comfortable providing active accountability

* Able to respectfully push me when necessary

* Excellent at written and spoken English

* Strong at research

* Detail-oriented

* Good at turning messy situations into organized systems

* Comfortable learning new software

* Comfortable communicating with clients

* Comfortable attending appropriate meetings

* Able to create professional SOPs and documentation

* Comfortable with Google Workspace and spreadsheets

* Able to handle changing priorities

* Able to distinguish urgent from non-urgent work

* Able to take ownership rather than constantly waiting for instructions

* Interested in finding more efficient ways of working



Experience with executive assistance, personal assistance, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, CRM systems, AI/productivity tools, bookkeeping administration, SOP creation, project coordination, or client communication is helpful.



## This Role Is Probably NOT For You If



This position may not be a good fit if you:



* Need detailed instructions for every task

* Prefer waiting for assignments rather than identifying what needs attention

* Are uncomfortable reminding your manager repeatedly

* Are uncomfortable respectfully challenging priorities

* Do not like frequent communication

* Are uncomfortable joining live Zoom work sessions

* Struggle when priorities change

* Send research without reviewing or organizing it first

* Frequently forget follow-ups

* Need every day to look exactly the same

* Are uncomfortable taking ownership of administrative problems





Some flexibility is important because occasional client meetings, appointments, or Zoom accountability sessions may happen later in the day.



I do **not** expect you to be available 24/7.



We can discuss the exact schedule based on mutual availability and determine what works best.



## Paid Trial & Long-Term Expectations



I want to be transparent from the beginning.



I would like to start with a **paid trial period**.



I am **not promising that this will automatically become a permanent long-term position.**



I want to first determine whether having you in this role genuinely reduces my workload and makes my life more organized.



During the trial, I will evaluate:



* How much work you actually remove from me

* Whether you proactively notice what needs attention

* Whether I constantly have to manage you

* Your organization

* Your reliability

* Your communication

* Your research quality

* Your judgment

* Your follow-through

* Your ability to learn

* Your ability to create useful systems

* Your ability to keep me accountable

* How comfortable we are working together closely

* Whether having you involved genuinely gives me more time and mental capacity



If you are genuinely helpful and we work well together, there may be an opportunity to continue and potentially expand the position to full time. 



I prefer being transparent about this instead of promising long-term work before we know whether we are a good fit.



## What Success Looks Like



Eventually, I want you to understand my responsibilities well enough that I can ask:



**“What should I be working on right now?”**



and you can help me answer that.



If I am supposed to be working on my master's degree but suddenly start doing something that can wait, I want you to respectfully redirect me.



If an employee needs a document, you help prepare it.



If a process needs an SOP, you create it.



If a client meeting needs preparation, you prepare it.



If an
 needs a response, you help prepare it.



If employment information needs to be transferred into my tracker, you organize it.



If I need to improve the way I work using voice instead of typing, you help me research, test, and implement that workflow.



If we need groceries, you prepare the list.



If I need to return something, you make sure I do not forget the return deadline.



If I need to attend an important program session, you make sure it stays on my radar.



If I need two hours of focused work, you can sit with me on Zoom and help make those two hours productive.



If something can reasonably be **organized, researched, prepared, documented, tracked, scheduled, coordinated, or followed up without requiring me personally**, I want you to take ownership of it.



The goal is to help me spend my limited time on my daughter and on the responsibilities that genuinely require me, instead of constantly losing hours to organization, research, paperwork,
s, and unfinished administrative tasks.



## How to Apply



Please answer all of the following:



1. Tell me briefly about yourself and your relevant experience.

2. Why does this combination of personal assistance, executive assistance, accountability, and business operations interest you?

3. Give me an example of something you proactively solved without being given detailed instructions.

4. How comfortable are you respectfully pushing your manager when something important is not getting completed?

5. Are you comfortable regularly joining Zoom for accountability/body-doubling sessions?

6. What experience do you have with Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, spreadsheets, CRM systems, and business documentation?

7. Have you created SOPs, checklists, training documents, or employee instructions before?

8. Do you have experience communicating with clients or attending client meetings?

9. Do you have experience tracking expenses, revenue, or basic bookkeeping?

10. Are you comfortable learning unfamiliar systems and documenting the process as you learn?

11. Are you comfortable with a role where priorities may change from day to day?

13. Are you comfortable beginning with a paid trial period with no guarantee of a long-term position?



Please begin your application with the words:



**SECOND BRAIN**



Applications that do not include these words may not be reviewed.

title: Real Estate Transaction Coordinator – Virtual Assistant
description:
Company: Raintown Realty

Position: Full-Time Virtual Assistant – Transaction Coordinator

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:30 PM Pacific Time

Compensation: $5–$8 USD per hour, depending on experience, plus performance bonuses



About the Position



Raintown Realty is looking for a dependable, organized, and detail-oriented Real Estate Transaction Coordinator Virtual Assistant to help manage our real estate transactions from contract to closing.



This is a full-time position for someone who is comfortable working in a fast-paced real estate environment, managing multiple deadlines, communicating with agents and vendors, and making sure every transaction stays organized and on schedule.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, follows through, communicates clearly, and pays close attention to details.



Primary Responsibilities



As our Transaction Coordinator, you will help manage transactions from the time a property goes under contract through closing.



Responsibilities may include:



Open new transaction files once a property goes under contract

Review contracts and transaction documents for completeness

Enter important dates, deadlines, and transaction information into our systems

Track inspection, financing, appraisal, title, escrow, and closing deadlines

Maintain accurate transaction checklists

Communicate with agents regarding missing documents or upcoming deadlines

Coordinate with escrow, title companies, lenders, inspectors, and other transaction parties

Send documents and reminders as needed

Upload and organize transaction documents

Maintain accurate digital transaction files

Assist with compliance paperwork

Track signatures and required documentation

Help prepare files for closing

Confirm important milestones throughout the transaction

Follow up consistently until required items are completed

Help agents stay organized and informed throughout the transaction

Assist with post-closing file organization when necessary

Qualifications



We are looking for someone who is:



Highly organized

Extremely detail-oriented

Dependable and punctual

Comfortable managing multiple transactions at the same time

Able to follow systems, checklists, and procedures

Excellent at follow-up

Comfortable communicating by phone,
, and messaging

Able to work independently

Able to recognize when something is missing or a deadline may be at risk

Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

English Requirements



Excellent English communication skills are required.



You should have:



Strong written English

Clear spoken English

Professional
 communication

Good grammar and spelling

The ability to communicate comfortably with U.S.-based real estate agents and service providers

Preferred Experience



Previous experience in U.S. real estate is strongly preferred.



Experience with any of the following is especially helpful:



Real estate transaction coordination

Washington State real estate transactions

Real estate contracts

Escrow and title companies

Mortgage lenders

MLS systems

Dotloop

Skyslope

TransactionDesk

Follow Up Boss

Google Workspace

DocuSign

CRM systems

Real estate compliance



Applicants with direct Transaction Coordinator experience will receive priority consideration.



Schedule



This is a full-time position.



Monday through Friday

8:30 AM–5:30 PM Pacific Time



You must be available and ready to work during these hours consistently.



Reliable attendance and punctuality are very important.



Compensation



Pay will range from:



$5–$8 USD per hour



Starting pay will depend on:



Transaction coordination experience

U.S. real estate experience

Knowledge of contracts and deadlines

English communication ability

Software experience

Overall skill level



We also offer performance bonuses for exceptional work.



Employees who are dependable, accurate, proactive, and help our transactions run smoothly will have opportunities to earn additional bonuses.



What Success Looks Like



A successful Transaction Coordinator at Raintown Realty:



Rarely misses deadlines

Keeps files organized

Follows up without needing constant reminders

Communicates problems early

Helps agents stay focused on their clients instead of paperwork

Keeps escrow, lenders, agents, and other parties informed

Takes responsibility for making sure transaction tasks are completed

Is dependable every single day



We are looking for someone who does not simply wait to be told what to do.



We want someone who looks at a transaction and thinks:



“What needs to happen next, who needs to do it, and how do I make sure it gets done?”



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



A brief description of your previous work experience

Any experience you have as a Transaction Coordinator

Your experience working with U.S. real estate companies

The real estate software you have used

Your expected hourly rate

A short voice recording introducing yourself

A description of how you stay organized when managing multiple transactions

title: Real Estate Media Operations & Quality Control Coordinator
description:
Elevare Creative is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Operations & Quality Control Coordinator to manage the post-production and delivery workflow for our real estate media.



This is not a photography position. Our photographers capture the properties, and most editing is handled through our editing systems and partners. Your responsibility is making sure every project is complete, polished, organized, and delivered to our clients at the highest standard.



You’ll be responsible for bringing together media from multiple platforms, checking everything for accuracy and quality, and making sure each client receives a complete final package on time.



If you enjoy creating organized workflows, catching small details others miss, and making sure everything is perfect before it reaches the client, this role is for you.



What You’ll Do



You’ll own the workflow from the moment a photographer uploads their media until the client receives their final delivery.



Responsibilities include:



* Monitor incoming and active projects in Tonomo

* Verify photographers have uploaded all required files

* Perform quality control on all photos before delivery

* Make Photoshop edits when necessary, including removing distractions, straightening objects, fixing minor imperfections, replacing skies, and other retouching

* Organize, rename, and prepare final photo sets

* Maintain organized Dropbox folders and project files

* Retrieve completed media and assets from platforms such as Matterport, CubiCasa, and Zillow 3D Home

* Download and organize Matterport 3D Tour assets

* Retrieve CubiCasa floor plans and associated files

* Review and prepare Zillow 3D Home tours for delivery

* Build and complete Zillow Showcase listings through Aryeo, making sure all required media and listing assets are properly uploaded and organized

* Upload photos, videos, 3D tours, floor plans, and other media into Tonomo

* Verify every ordered service is completed before delivering a project

* Deliver completed projects to clients

* Handle client revision requests and make sure revisions are completed promptly

* Coordinate virtual staging orders and retrieve completed staged images

* Follow up with photographers or team members regarding missing files or incomplete projects

* Maintain delivery timelines and keep projects moving through the workflow

* Catch missing, incorrect, or low-quality media before it reaches the client

* Ensure every project meets Elevare Creative’s quality standards



Requirements



* Exceptional attention to detail

* Strong organizational and file-management skills

* Experience using Adobe Photoshop

* Experience using Adobe Lightroom

* Comfortable performing photo retouching and corrections when needed

* Experience organizing and managing files in Dropbox

* Strong written English and communication skills

* Reliable internet connection

* Comfortable working across multiple software platforms

* Comfortable learning new software and workflows quickly

* Able to follow detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

* Able to manage multiple projects and deadlines at once

* Comfortable taking ownership of projects and identifying issues without needing constant supervision



Experience with real estate media workflows is strongly preferred but not required if you are highly organized and willing to learn.



Software & Platforms



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Tonomo

* Adobe Photoshop

* Adobe Lightroom

* Dropbox

* Matterport

* CubiCasa

* Zillow 3D Home

* Zillow Showcase

* Aryeo

* AutoHDR

* Virtual staging platforms

* Other real estate media delivery or project management software



Application Questions



1. Have you worked with real estate photography or real estate media before? Tell us about your experience.

2. How would you rate your Photoshop skills: Beginner, Intermediate, or Advanced? What types of edits are you comfortable making?

3. Have you ever been responsible for quality control before delivering work to a client? Please explain your process.

4. Have you worked with Tonomo, Aryeo, Matterport, CubiCasa, Zillow 3D Home, Zillow Showcase, AutoHDR, Dropbox, or similar software? Please list the platforms you have experience with.

5. Have you ever been responsible for gathering files or deliverables from multiple platforms and organizing them into one final client delivery? Please explain.

6. How do you make sure nothing is missing when managing multiple projects at the same time?

7. What days and hours are you typically available each week?

8. Why do you think you’d be a good fit for this role?

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator - Solutions & Delivery
description:
Senior Salesforce Administrator | Work From Home | Full Time



We’re OpenCorp. For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped everyday Australians build wealth through property with the right strategy, advice and ongoing support. 



We’re looking for an experienced Senior Salesforce Administrator to join our Technology Team. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can do more than administer Salesforce — you’ll work with stakeholders to understand business problems, design smart solutions and take them all the way from discovery through to delivery. 



You’ll play a key role in how Salesforce supports our business, balancing day-to-day platform administration with solution design, project delivery, continuous improvement and mentoring other Salesforce Administrators. 



What you’ll be doing:



- Owning day-to-day Salesforce administration, including users, permissions, security, reports, dashboards, data quality and platform health 

- Managing and resolving Salesforce support requests while looking beyond the immediate issue to identify opportunities for improvement 

- Working directly with stakeholders to understand business problems, processes and desired outcomes 

- Leading discovery sessions and translating business requirements into practical Salesforce solutions 

- Designing and building scalable solutions using Salesforce Flow, validation rules, formulas, approvals, custom objects and other declarative tools 

- Managing Salesforce projects from discovery and solution design through build, testing, UAT, deployment and post-release support 

- Reviewing Salesforce solutions developed by other team members to ensure quality, maintainability and consistency 

- Helping strengthen our Salesforce DevOps and release-management practices 

- Supporting integrations, APIs, data migrations and other connected business platforms 

- Creating clear solution, technical, process and user documentation 

- Mentoring Salesforce Administrators and sharing knowledge across the Technology Team 

- Continuously identifying ways Salesforce can reduce manual work, improve data quality and create a better user experience 



We’re looking for someone with 

- At least 4 years of demonstrated Salesforce experience, including senior administration or consulting responsibilities 

- Salesforce Certified Administrator certification 

- Salesforce Platform App Builder certification or equivalent demonstrated capability 

- Advanced hands-on experience with Salesforce Flow and declarative automation 

- Proven experience taking Salesforce projects from discovery and requirements through build, UAT and deployment 

- Experience working directly with business stakeholders and confidently leading solution discussions 

- Practical experience with Salesforce DevOps, source control, structured deployments or release-management tools 

- Experience conducting peer reviews and applying Salesforce development standards 

- Experience supporting integrations, data migrations or connected business systems 

- Strong problem-solving skills with the confidence to challenge a request and understand the real business problem before building a solution 

- Excellent written and spoken English with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders 

- A strong focus on quality, documentation, scalability and long-term maintainability 



Highly regarded

- Experience working remotely with Australian, UK or US stakeholders 

- Exposure to Agile delivery, Jira and Confluence 



About you 

- You’re an experienced Salesforce professional who likes understanding why something needs to change before d
 how to build it. 

- You’re comfortable getting hands-on in Salesforce, but you can also step back and think about the bigger picture — the business process, user experience, data, integrations and long-term impact of a solution.

You care about building solutions that are scalable, maintainable and genuinely useful, and you enjoy helping other team members strengthen their Salesforce capability along the way.

title: Full-Time WordPress Developer & SEO Website Manager
description:
FULL-TIME WORDPRESS DEVELOPER & SEO WEBSITE MANAGER

Remote (Philippines-based) | Full-time | $500 USD/month



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word SAGE so we know you read the full post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're a multi-region women's health and fitness franchise (AU/NZ, Canada, US) looking for a full-time developer to own our WordPress website end-to-end — technical build work, security, SEO execution, and getting our blog/email content out the door. You'll work directly with, and be led by, our project lead in Sydney, who will give you clear written briefs, direction, and regular check-ins along the way. You won't be left to figure everything out on your own — this is a genuinely managed role with hands-on leadership.



What we're hoping for is someone who takes real ownership of the work they're given: delivers what was asked, tests it before calling it done, and flags problems early rather than going quiet — and who grows into more independence over time as they learn our systems. We don't expect you to arrive already running the whole website unsupervised.



This is a hands-on technical role, not a support/ticket role. You'll be trusted with real production systems from week one, with clear guidance every step of the way.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



WordPress Development & Site Management

- Customize and extend the site's theme (Sage/Blade framework) and flexible content fields (ACF Flexible Content / Gutenberg blocks) to build new page layouts and modules

- Maintain four regional site variants (AU, NZ, CA, US) via WPML

- Perform monthly core/theme/plugin maintenance with zero downtime

- Work in our GitHub repo — proper branches, pull requests, clear commit messages, staging deploys

- Manage WP Engine hosting (staging, deploys, backups)

- Handle API integrations — booking/scheduling platforms and GoHighLevel (GHL) automations



SEO & AI Search Visibility

- Execute on-page SEO: meta tags, header structure, image alt-text, schema/structured data (Yoast or RankMath)

- Apply AIO/AEO best practices — structuring content (FAQ/HowTo schema, answer-first formatting) so it gets picked up by Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and similar AI search tools

- Evaluate and use SEO/keyword monitoring tools (e.g. SEMrush)



Content & Campaign Distribution

- Publish weekly blog posts provided by the content team — formatting, imagery, links, SEO/AIO structure (you won't be writing the copy)

- Build, test, and deploy Mailchimp email campaigns tied to blog content to drive traffic; manage segmentation and automated workflows



Security & Technical Health

- Manage Wordfence security, credential rotation, and secrets storage

- Run plugin audits and manage license decisions

- Proactively catch bugs, broken functionality, and site speed issues



Working with AI Tools

- Use AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to speed up development — while still reviewing, understanding, and taking ownership of everything shipped

- Be ready to explain specifically how you've used AI tools on past projects, not just that you're aware of them



REQUIRED SKILLS



- 3+ years hands-on WordPress development (PHP, ACF — including Flexible Content field layouts — Gutenberg, a modern theme framework like Sage/Blade, Timber, or Roots)

- Solid Git/GitHub workflow — branching, PRs, resolving conflicts

- On-page SEO execution experience (Yoast/RankMath) and awareness of AI-search optimization trends (AIO/AEO/GEO)

- Experience with Mailchimp or a similar ESP for campaign building

- API integration experience

- Conversational English strong enough to follow Zoom calls and multi-step verbal instructions. You won't be writing marketing copy, so full fluency isn't required — but you do need to understand and be understood live. This is assessed as part of the process.

- Demonstrated experience using AI tools to speed up real development work (not just "I've heard of Copilot")

- Able to take a clear written brief and run with it, asking smart clarifying questions rather than guessing — you'll have ongoing leadership and direction, so this is about taking ownership of assigned work, not managing the whole website unsupervised



NICE-TO-HAVE



- Direct GoHighLevel experience (workflows, Communities, Courses/Memberships, Client Portal)

- Basic graphic skills in Canva or similar, for preparing blog images

- Google Analytics / Search Console experience

- Experience with Notion as a project management tool — all our documentation and project management runs through it, though this is easy to pick up if you haven't used it before



WORK STYLE WE NEED



- Full-time hours, but no fixed 9-5 required — you're welcome to structure your day however suits you, as long as your full-time hours are covered and you're available for scheduled meetings at reasonable times

- Takes a clear, written task and runs with it — you'll get direction and leadership, not silence, so this is about follow-through rather than figuring it all out alone

- Proactive communicator — flags blockers, asks sharp questions, reports back clearly rather than going quiet

- Willing to learn, adapt, and take on new challenges you're unfamiliar with — you won't know everything on day one, and that's expected



COMPENSATION & LOGISTICS



- $500 USD/month, full-time contractor role

- Fully remote

- Reports to: Project Lead (Sydney, Australia)



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with a message that starts with the word SAGE and includes LINKS to the following (Google Drive, Loom, or similar — make sure sharing is set to "anyone with the link"):



1. Your CV/resume

2. Portfolio or live site examples

3. Your GitHub profile

4. A short video (max 7 minutes) answering these prompts out loud:

   - Introduce yourself and your development background.

   - Walk us through a project you're proud of — what was your specific role?

   - Tell us about a time you got stuck on a technical problem. What did you do?



Please don't read from a script — you're welcome to think through your answers beforehand, but we want to hear you speak naturally, not recite something written. Applications missing the video or GitHub link will not be shortlisted.



We look forward to reviewing your appliaction and potentially welcoming you to the team.

title: Bookkeeping, Billing & Accounts Receivable Coordinator
description:
About the Position



American Debate | Agape Consulting Group is a U.S.-based education organization that works with schools and school districts.



We are looking for a highly organized, dependable, and professional Bookkeeping, Billing & Accounts Receivable Coordinator to help manage our financial records and the administrative process related to school and district payments.



This is not simply a data-entry position.



You will be responsible for keeping our financial records organized, tracking Work Orders (WO), Purchase Orders (PO), invoices and payments, and communicating professionally with school principals, secretaries, purchasing departments, and accounts-payable departments.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of tasks and follows through until they are completed.

You will:



Maintain our QuickBooks Online records

Categorize income and expenses

Record and match transactions

Reconcile bank accounts

Reconcile credit-card accounts

Maintain Accounts Receivable (A/R)

Maintain Accounts Payable (A/P)

Match payments to invoices

Identify missing, duplicate, or incorrect transactions

Prepare basic monthly reports, including P&L, Balance Sheet, and A/R Aging

PO number

Services completed

Payment status

Notes/next action

Track outstanding invoices

You should be able to answer accurately.

:



Principals

Accounts Payable experience

title: Short-Form Editor / Graphic Designer **Rockstars Only**
description:
Are you an A player? We want you on our team!



Here's the wrong version of this role: someone who logs on, asks what they should work on, sends three "just checking if this looks right?" messages, and waits. We already know what needs to be made. We wrote it down. If the brief and the brand bible are sitting in your queue and you still need a call to start, this isn't a fit.



Here's the right version: you pull a task, read the brief once, look at the last three approved assets for that client, and build something that looks like it belongs next to them. You submit it. It's right the first time more often than it isn't. When something is genuinely ambiguous, you ask specific questions in one message and keep working on something else while you wait.



What you'll make



Short-form video (Reels, TikToks, paid ad cuts) and the static side of it: carousels, feed graphics, flyers, ad creative. Real small businesses with real ad spend behind some of it. Multiple clients, multiple brand voices, switched between in the same afternoon.



Tools you should already be fluent in



CapCut and DaVinci Resolve or equivalent for video. Photoshop and the Adobe suite or equivalent for design. Canva for anything going into a client's hands. We won't train you on these. We will absolutely train you on our clients.



How this works



You're online during a set daily window so revisions and the occasional rush don't sit overnight. Inside that window, nobody hovers. There's no no hour-by-hour reporting. What we measure is whether assets land on time, in the naming convention, at the right quality, and how fast you respond when a revision comes in.



The rules that aren't negotiable: brand bible before you start, naming convention on every file, new version every time (never overwrite), and when you're blocked you say so immediately instead of quietly stalling. Two people review your work and both will tell you plainly when something misses.



Who we're looking for



We're a growing agency, and we're building the team that takes us to the next stage. Your work is seen by the people who d
 things, on the day you do it.



We're hiring for a seat, not a project. We'd rather train one person properly over several years than churn through six editors in one. So we care less about whether you know every shortcut in Resolve today and more about whether you'll know them in six months because you went and learned them on your own. As we grow, the people who grew with us get first claim on what comes next.



What we're actually looking for in a person:



You tell the truth about your work. If you missed a deadline, you say so before we find out. If you didn't understand the brief, you say that too, instead of guessing and hoping. We've never once been upset with someone for saying "I don't know how to do this yet." We have been upset with silence.



You communicate without being chased. A short message that says what's done, what's stuck, and what you need is worth more to us than an hour of perfect work we didn't know was happening. Going quiet is the single fastest way to lose this job.



You get better on purpose. You watch how other editors cut, you notice when a style is shifting, you bring an idea occasionally instead of only executing. Nobody here will build you a curriculum. The people who do well are the ones who improve because they wanted to.



You move without being pushed. When the queue is empty you say so instead of waiting to be found. When something is obviously broken you flag it. When you finish early you ask what's next. That instinct is most of what we mean by independent, and you either have it or you don't.



You take criticism as information. Your work gets reviewed, and you'll be told plainly when something misses. It's not personal and it isn't a comment on you. Editors who take feedback as an insult burn out fast. Editors who take it as data get very good, very quickly.



What we'll give back:



Honest feedback, consistent and on-time pay, clear briefs, and real autonomy inside your shift. We won't message you after hours. We won't ask you to pretend to be busy. And if you're good, we'll keep you for years and grow the role around you. We care about all members of our team and want to see you grow and succeed in life.



If this sounds like a fit for you - Send over your portfolio for a chance to enter the trial task phase

title: Listing & Customer Service VA for Online Fashion Shops — daily shift, long-term
description:
Hi! I run online fashion and accessories shops selling on Depop.

I'm looking for one reliable person to post listings and handle customer messages.



This starts at around 12 hours a week — roughly 1.5 to 2 hours every day, 7 days a

week. Listings go out daily and customers message on weekends, so it's a short daily

shift rather than long weekday blocks.



Be aware this is a STARTING amount. The work scales quickly and I want to grow this

into full-time hours for the right person. I'm hiring for the long term, not a

short project.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Posting listings. This is the bulk of the job and where most of your time goes.

  The target is around 125 listings a day across several shops (about 25 per shop).

- Replying to customer messages. Only about 5 minutes per shop per day.

- A quick daily check that orders are moving as they should, and flagging anything

  that looks wrong.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU

- EXPERIENCE LISTING PRODUCTS on an online marketplace. This is a requirement, not

  a nice-to-have. eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Vinted, Shopify, Etsy, Depop — any of

  them is fine, but you need to have done volume listing before.

- Excellent WRITTEN English. You'll be writing to young customers, so it needs to

  sound natural and friendly, not formal or robotic.

- Good SPOKEN English — we'll talk regularly.

- A stable internet connection. You'll be working through a remote desktop, so a

  dropout means you can't work.

- Available every day, including weekends. The shift is short but it has to happen

  daily — listings not posted and messages left overnight cost me sales.

- Someone who asks when they're unsure instead of guessing. I would much rather

  answer a question than fix a mistake.



I'm completely fine with you having other clients or work alongside this, as long as

the daily shift happens. If you'd rather build up to full-time with me instead, that

option is there too.



WHAT I DON'T NEED

- Depop experience specifically. I'll train you and we have written procedures for

  everything.

- A team or an agency. I'm hiring one person directly.



THE SETUP

You'll work through a remote desktop that I provide. Everything is already logged

in, so you never have to handle passwords or accounts.



PAY

$5 USD/hour to start, paid weekly. Reviewed after the first month, and it goes up

with hours and responsibility.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your reply with the word LANTERN so I know you read this properly.



Then tell me, briefly:

1. Where you've listed products before, and roughly how many per day

2. Your internet speed (screenshot from a speed test)

3. What hours you can work (your local time is fine)

4. Your WhatsApp number



Shortlisted applicants get a short PAID test task (about 30 minutes, paid $5 USD)

before any interview — I pay for your time either way. After that there's a paid

settling-in period while I walk you through how everything works.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Negentropy Limited is a Hong Kong–based social marketing agency operating in the fast-paced e-commerce space. We work with performance-driven teams focused on execution, speed, and results.



We are not a “chill” company. We are a high-accountability environment where people are expected to deliver, improve, and take ownership daily.



THE ROLE

We are hiring a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Virtual Media Buying Assistant who can support advertising operations through data tracking, reporting, documentation, and campaign-related administrative support.



This role is for someone who:

- Takes ownership without being chased

- Communicates clearly and professionally

- Handles sensitive business information with professionalism and discretion

- Thrives in a structured, performance-based environment

If you need constant reminders, supervision, or struggle to stay organized—this role is not for you.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Assist in preparing reports, presentations, and executive documents

- Organize and maintain files, records, and documentation

- Support ad hoc tasks, projects, and executive priorities

- Assist with basic tracking and organization of advertising or campaign data

- Assist in tracking advertising performance data and maintaining campaign records

- Maintain confidentiality and professionalism at all times

- Ensure accuracy and completeness of outputs before submission

- Coordinate with internal teams as needed for task completion



STANDARDS & WORK STYLE

Our team operates on trust, clarity, and consistent execution. People who thrive here tend to naturally demonstrate:

1. Integrity in Communication – Handling confidential and sensitive information responsibly

2. Consistency – Showing up prepared, organized, and reliable across tasks

3. Ownership Mindset – Taking responsibility for tasks and following through without being chased

4. Structured Work Habits – Maintaining organized files, data tracking systems, and workflows

5. Professional Discipline – Managing responsibilities effectively with minimal supervision

This role suits individuals who value clarity, accountability, and steady performance over time.



APPLICATION FIT

Candidates who tend to do well in this role are those who:

- Prefer structured workflows and clear direction

- Take pride in delivering accurate, organized work

- Communicate clearly and professionally

- Can manage multiple tasks with attention to detail

- Are comfortable working with documentation and data tracking

- Comfortable working with spreadsheets, reports, and performance data

- Are comfortable working during morning or daytime shifts with consistent availability

- Can fully commit to a full-time role and prioritize their responsibilities during working hours



On the other hand, this role may feel restrictive for those who:

- Prefer highly flexible or loosely defined work setups

- Struggle with organization and time management

- Submit rushed, incomplete, or unreviewed outputs

- Dislike repetitive or administrative tasks

- Prefer late-night schedules or have inconsistent daytime availability

- Plan to balance multiple full-time jobs or commitments that may affect availability or performance



QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree (fresh graduates are welcome)

- Experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or similar role is an advantage

- Strong organizational and time-management skills

- Strong English communication skills (written and verbal)

- Proficient in Google Workspace (especially Google Sheets)

- Comfortable working with spreadsheets, reports, and data tracking

- Detail-oriented with good documentation and tracking skills

- Able to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Stable internet connection (minimum 50 - 100 Mbps)

Laptop/PC with at least:

- 8GB RAM

- Intel i5 (or equivalent) or higher

- 256GB storage or higher

For Mac Users:

- 8GB unified memory or more

- Apple M1 chip or newer (or Intel i5 and above)

- 256GB SSD or more



SALARY: 18,000–23,000 PHP per month



WORK SCHEDULE & SETUP:

- Employment Type: Contractual

- Contract Term: 6 months (renewable based on performance and business needs)

- Work Setup: Remote

- 5 working days per week with 2 rest days

- 8 working hours per day with a 1-hour lunch break

- Schedule may vary depending on business needs

- Morning shift (Philippine Time)

- Must have own laptop and a reliable internet connection

- This is a full-time position that requires consistent availability and commitment during scheduled working hours.



If you are interested
 your application letter and resume to negentropylimitedhk at gmail with the subject title "Media Buying Assistant - Job Application (Your Full name)

title: Quantity Surveying & Commercial Assistant
description:
PART-TIME QUANTITY SURVEYING & COMMERCIAL ASSISTANT – UK CONSTRUCTION CONSULTANCY



Hours: 20 hours per week

Location: Remote

Salary: Up to USD $500 per month (Dependent on Experience)

Performance Reviews: Weekly check-ins and formal monthly reviews

Probation: Initial 3-month probation, followed by a further development/probation period through to a final 6-month review

Long-Term Opportunity: Potential for increased responsibility, salary, hours and progression



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a growing UK-based construction and property consultancy looking for a capable, organised and commercially minded Quantity Surveying & Commercial Assistant to work directly with the Technical Director.



This is not a standard Virtual Assistant role.



The position will primarily support Quantity Surveying, commercial management and consultancy work, while also helping with tenders, fee proposals, lead tracking, business development and internal systems.



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of the business and gradually take ownership of repeatable commercial and administrative workstreams.



The role will start at 20 hours per week.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Quantity Surveying & Commercial Support



– Prepare and update construction cost models

– Assist with project cashflows and forecasts

– Update cost reports and commercial trackers

– Review and organise contractor cost information

– Assist with valuations and variation/change registers

– Carry out cost benchmarking and rate research

– Prepare Excel-based commercial analysis

– Review supporting information and identify missing information

– Prepare first drafts of commercial reports for senior review

– Support tender analysis and procurement activities



Consultancy & Bid Support



– Prepare first drafts of fee proposals

– Review tender documents and extract submission requirements

– Prepare tender compliance checklists

– Track tender opportunities and submission deadlines

– Compile tender submissions

– Maintain project case studies and staff CV information

– Research potential clients and opportunities

– Follow up business development leads

– Assist with professional
s and correspondence



Systems & Business Improvement



– Improve Excel templates

– Develop standard commercial reporting templates

– Document repeatable processes

– Build checklists and procedures

– Maintain project and tender databases

– Organise company information for efficient reuse

– Use technology and AI tools, including ChatGPT, to improve productivity and quality



When project workloads are quieter, you may also assist with structured research, lead generation and property-related commercial analysis.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You do not need to know everything on Day 1.



However, you should have a good foundation in construction and be comfortable working with numbers, commercial information and detailed documents.



ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



- Degree, qualification or relevant experience in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Civil Engineering or a related construction discipline.

- Experience with construction costs, estimating, quantity surveying or commercial management.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills.

- Ability to read drawings, specifications and construction information.

- Good numerical and analytical ability.

- Very good written and spoken English.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

- Comfortable researching information independently.

- Willing to learn UK construction processes and terminology.

- Comfortable receiving feedback and having work reviewed.

- Reliable internet connection and suitable computer for remote working.



DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE



Experience in any of the following would be an advantage:



– UK Quantity Surveying

– UK construction consultancy

– JCT or NEC contracts

– Cost planning

– Bills of Quantities

– Schedules of works

– Interim valuations

– Variations and change management

– Cost reporting

– Tender analysis

– Procurement

– Final accounts

– Bluebeam

– CostX

– Planswift

– BCIS

– Public-sector construction projects

– Bid or tender preparation



Previous UK experience is desirable but not essential if you have a strong technical foundation and are willing to learn.



THE PERSON WE WANT



Technical ability is important, but attitude is equally important.



We are particularly interested in someone who:



– Takes ownership of tasks

– Asks sensible questions

– Notices when information does not look correct

– Can turn an unclear task into an organised process

– Is comfortable learning new software and systems

– Looks for ways to improve how work is completed

– Understands the importance of accuracy and confidentiality

– Wants to develop professionally rather than simply complete assigned tasks



You will work closely with a Chartered Quantity Surveyor who will initially review and quality-assure your technical outputs.



As your experience develops, you will be given increasing responsibility and ownership of workstreams.



WORKING ARRANGEMENTS



This is a 20-hour-per-week part-time remote position.



There will be flexibility in when work is completed. A work schedule will be agreed but you need to be available at least 4 out of 5 days of the week during the UK working day.



We value accuracy, reliability and output more than being permanently online.



The starting salary is up to USD $500 per month.



REVIEWS, PROBATION & PROGRESSION



- Weekly check-ins will be used to discuss workload, priorities, questions and immediate feedback.

- Formal monthly performance reviews will cover quality, reliability, development areas and increasing responsibility.

- The role will begin with an initial 3-month probation period.

- At the 3-month point, performance, salary, responsibilities and working arrangements will be formally reviewed.

- Subject to satisfactory performance, the role will continue into a further development/probation period.

- A final probation review will take place at the 6-month point.

- Subject to successful completion of probation, the intention is to move the successful candidate into a more established long-term role within the business.



For the right person, there is potential for:



– Increased salary

– Increased hours

– Greater ownership of projects and workstreams

– Progression into a Quantity Surveyor / Senior Quantity Surveyor position

– Helping train future team members

– Involvement across our wider construction and property businesses



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship, not just a short-term freelance assignment.



HOW TO APPLY



Please provide the following:



Your CV or resume.

A short introduction explaining why this role interests you.

A video introduction of yourself.

A brief summary of your Quantity Surveying, estimating or commercial construction experience.

Your level of experience with Microsoft Excel.

Any experience you have working on UK, Australian, New Zealand or similar construction projects.

Details of any Quantity Surveying or estimating software you have used.



Please begin your application with the words:



Commercial QS



This helps us identify applicants who have read the full job description.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short practical exercise before interview.



Please do not worry if you do not meet every desirable requirement. We are looking for a strong combination of technical potential, analytical ability, reliability and willingness to learn.

title: Private Investigator / Researcher
description:
Job Title: Researcher.

Type of work: Private Investigation - Contractor.



Compensation: You will begin with a compensation of $740 USD per month ($370 USD biweekly), with performance-based increases to be considered after the first, second, third, fourth, sixth, and twelfth months.



As a reference point, most of our candidates are earning $890 after the sixth month.



Schedule: Monday through Friday 9 AM - 5 PM (PST).



About the Role:



We are seeking a motivated individual to join our team as a Private Investigator (Contractor), focusing on insurance research. This is a fully remote, long-term, work-from-home position. You will be hired as an independent contractor, not as an employee.



While you will have some freedom to manage your own schedule, please note that our company operates within U.S. business hours. All completed cases must be submitted between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM (Pacific Standard Time), as support is only available during these times. Please do not apply unless you have full availability during these hours.



Please note that your performance will be reviewed at the end of the first and second months, which constitute the Onboarding/Training period. Based on the results of these evaluations, we will determine whether to continue a long-term working relationship.



When applying, please mention your English level, and send us a short audio introducing yourself.



Job Requirements



• Language: English (C2 - Advanced, or native proficiency). Preference will be given to candidates with a neutral or minimal accent.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in any field. The specific area of study is not important, but an undergraduate degree is required.

• Experience: A minimum of 2 years of experience as an Insurance Researcher or, alternatively, at least 5 years of experience in a different field. Comprehensive in-house training will be provided to less experienced individuals.



Skills & Traits We Value



We have a hands-off approach to management, so success in this role requires independence and accountability. Ideal candidates will demonstrate the following:



• Strong self-motivation and discipline.

• Excellent attention to detail.

• Ability to learn quickly.

• Openness to feedback and constructive criticism.

• Effective time management skills.

• Strong problem-solving abilities.

• Personal accountability for results.

• Clear and consistent communication.



Benefits:



• Paid training (3 Sessions).

• US Federal Holidays are off.

• Somewhat Flexible.

title: Customer Resolution & Refund Specialist — Part-Time Remote
description:
DRIVE Roadside is looking for a highly organized, analytical, and dependable Customer Resolution & Refund Specialist to manage customer refund requests, customer
s, and related back-office issues.



This is not a sales position and is primarily non-phone-based.



The most important part of this position is determining what actually happened with each customer request before making a decision.



You will investigate individual roadside-assistance jobs, reconstruct the timeline, review provider activity and customer communications, and determine the appropriate resolution based on DRIVE’s established policies.



We are looking for someone who can research, problem-solve, make sound decisions, and follow company policy consistently.



Responsibilities



* Review and investigate customer refund requests.

* Reconstruct the timeline of each roadside-assistance job.

* Determine when the customer placed the order, when a provider was assigned, and how long the customer waited.

* Determine whether a provider was dispatched, en route, on scene, or had already incurred costs.

* Review customer and provider communications when necessary.

* Determine whether a cancellation occurred before or after service/provider commitments were made.

* Identify whether DRIVE, the service provider, or another circumstance caused the service issue.

* Apply DRIVE’s refund and cancellation policies exactly and consistently.

* Approve or process refunds when they meet established criteria.

* Decline refund requests when the circumstances do not qualify under company policy.

* Escalate unusual or ambiguous cases to management rather than guessing.

* Respond professionally and clearly to customer
s.

* Document the investigation, decision, and supporting information for each case.

* Identify recurring problems or trends that management should know about.

* Assist with other customer-resolution and back-office administrative tasks as needed.



What We’re Looking For



You should have excellent written English and be comfortable independently investigating a situation rather than simply following a basic checklist.



Strong candidates will have:



* Excellent problem-solving and investigative skills.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Excellent written English.

* Good judgment and common sense.

* Ability to follow detailed policies precisely.

* Ability to remain objective when reviewing customer complaints.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

* Experience with customer service, refunds, disputes, escalations, or back-office operations.

* Experience using CRM/help-desk software such as Zendesk or similar systems is preferred.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.

* Ability to maintain confidentiality when working with customer information.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role isn’t measured by approving or denying the most refunds. It’s measured by getting the decision right.



Every case should be properly investigated, supported by the facts, handled according to DRIVE’s policies, documented clearly, and resolved promptly.



Schedule



This position will begin at approximately 10 hours per week. We expect the position to grow as responsibilities and volume increase.



Some overlap with U.S. business hours will be required for communication with management, but much of the work can be completed independently.

title: Experienced in Hubspot , Payments and Point of Sales

Work Arrangement: Remote

Pay: $12/hour

Schedule: Full-time

Industry: Restaurant Technology / Point-of-Sale / Payments / SaaS



About Pye



Pye is a growing restaurant technology company providing self-order kiosks, POS technology, payments, guest intelligence, and AI-powered restaurant solutions.



We are expanding our sales team and looking for an experienced SDR who understands the restaurant technology ecosystem and can identify, qualify, and generate high-quality opportunities for our sales closers.



The Role



The SDR will be responsible for prospecting restaurant businesses, qualifying leads, conducting outbound outreach, and scheduling qualified meetings for Pye's sales team.

- Point-of-sale (POS) systems

- Payment processing

- Restaurant technology

- SaaS

- B2B sales

- CRM systems

- Outbound prospecting

Key Responsibilities

- Make outbound calls and send targeted
s

- POS systems

- Restaurant technology

- SaaS sales

- B2B technology sales

- Fintech

- Kiosk technology

- CRM-based sales development



Required Skills



- 2+ years of B2B SDR/BDR experience preferred

- Hands-on experience using HubSpot

- Strong outbound calling and
 skills

- Excellent English communication skills

- Comfortable speaking with business owners and executives

- Ability to qualify prospects rather than simply make calls

- Strong follow-up and organization

- Ability to research companies and identify decision-makers

- Comfortable learning technology and explaining it simply

- Highly self-motivated and able to work independently

- Strong attention to detail



HubSpot Experience



You should be comfortable using HubSpot to:



- Create and update contacts

- Manage deals/leads

- Log calls and
s

- Schedule follow-ups

- Track lead stages

- Maintain accurate CRM information

- Manage your daily prospecting pipeline

We want someone who thinks like a sales professional, not simply a caller.

Is this a good Pye customer?

Who is the decision-maker?

What POS are they using?

How many locations do they have?

What problem might Pye solve?

Is this lead worth pursuing?

Success in this role will be measured by:

- Prospecting activity

- Follow-up discipline

- CRM accuracy

- Ability to consistently move qualified prospects toward a sales conversation



Compensation



$12/hour



This is a full-time position with the opportunity to grow with Pye as the company expands.



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume

2. A brief summary of your B2B sales experience

3. Your experience with payments, POS, restaurant technology, or SaaS

4. Your experience using HubSpot

5. Your previous SDR/BDR responsibilities and sales results

6. Your availability and preferred working hours



Important: In your application, please begin your message with "PYE SDR" so we know you carefully read the posting.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with a technology company and become an important part of our sales organization.

It helps private medical consultants grow their practices through AI-driven visibility and patient acquisition — ranking them top-3 on Google Maps and AI search to drive self-pay patient calls. - Internal linking

- Meta titles and descriptions

- Content structure

- The importance of accuracy and trustworthiness in healthcare content



Preferred Experience

- Digital marketing agencies

- Doctors, clinics, hospitals, or medical organisations

- WordPress

- Google Docs

Who We Are Looking For

You must have a reliable computer, stable internet connection, and be available during agreed working hours.



Application Requirements
