title: Senior Media Buyer - Meta
description:
Senior Media Buyer (Meta Ads, Affiliate Lead Generation) - Remote, Full-Time



We are looking for Senior Media Buyer to run Meta ad campaigns for affiliate lead-generation offers. 



This is a remote, full-time position.



You will be the person who takes a new offer, tests it, finds what works, and scales it. You report directly to the owner and work inside our own Business Manager, tracker, and creative pipeline.



This is NOT an e-commerce role. We do not sell products or run stores.



We generate leads and calls for affiliate offers in home services (bathroom remodeling, roofing, windows, solar, HVAC, and similar) and in the refinancing and mortgage space (cash-out refinance, home equity, debt consolidation).



If your Meta experience is only in e-commerce, dropshipping, or brand awareness, this role is NOT the right fit.



You must have hands-on experience as a Meta Ads Manager buyer for affiliate lead-generation offers. That means you have personally built campaigns, written the targeting, chosen the creatives, set the budgets, read the numbers every morning, and made the kill, keep, or scale decision yourself.



You know how a lead-gen funnel differs from a store checkout, and you know how to read a campaign when the payout comes from the network and not from the Meta pixel.



You must be able to show your testing and scaling methodology, not just describe it. In the interview you will walk us through how you approach a brand-new offer: how you structure the first launch, how many ad sets and creatives you start with, what daily budgets you use, what your kill rules are, and when you d
 an offer is worth scaling.



We expect you to know and be able to explain the Brazilian testing method, when you use CBO versus ABO, how you move a winner from testing into a scaling structure, and how you handle creative fatigue. If you have your own variations on these methods, even better, but you must be able to defend them with numbers from campaigns you have actually run.



You must have experience working with affiliate networks. You know how to read a network dashboard, how caps and payouts work, how to set up postbacks and sub IDs, how to talk to an affiliate manager, and how to tell the difference between a tracking problem and a bad campaign. Experience with a click tracker (RedTrack, Voluum, ClickFlare, or similar) is expected.



Your day-to-day responsibilities: launch and manage campaigns across multiple ad accounts and offers, monitor spend and lead quality daily, request and brief new creatives from our creative team, keep a clear record of every test and its result, protect the ad accounts by following Meta's policies and our internal rules, and report performance in plain numbers, not stories.



Reliability is a hard requirement.  You must attend a daily team meeting on video, camera on, Monday through Friday, at a time set with the team. You must be reachable during working hours and you must tell us before a problem becomes a surprise. Missed meetings and silent days are the fastest way to lose this position.



What we offer: a remote full-time role with a stable workload, offers with real budgets, a creative team producing new ads for you, our own tracking and automation tools, and direct access to the owner with no layers in between.



Compensation is p40000 per month.

title: NinjaTrader / NinjaScript Developer | Automated Futures Systems & Product Strategy
description:
KJD Capital is looking for an experienced NinjaTrader 8 / NinjaScript Developer to design, build, test, deploy, and maintain automated futures trading systems.



We are not looking for someone who simply writes indicators or converts basic rules into code. We want a developer who understands futures markets, systematic trading, live execution, risk management, performance validation, and the commercial side of building a high-value automated trading product.



A major objective of this role is to help us develop systems that can progress from research and backtesting into forward testing and live trading, with performance documented through credible live brokerage records.



The ideal candidate can also work with management on product strategy—helping determine which systems, features, risk configurations, and performance characteristics make the product compelling for a high-ticket automated trading offer.



Main Responsibilities

NinjaTrader Strategy Development

Develop automated futures trading strategies in NinjaTrader 8

Write clean and maintainable NinjaScript / C#

Convert trading concepts and detailed specifications into functioning automated systems

Develop new strategies from the ground up

Modify and improve existing strategies

Build custom indicators and supporting tools

Develop sophisticated entry and exit logic

Build stop-loss and profit-target management

Create trailing-stop and break-even functionality

Implement time-of-day and session filters

Build position-sizing and contract-sizing logic

Create daily profit/loss limits and account-level risk controls

Develop multi-timeframe and multi-data-series strategies where necessary

Troubleshoot execution and order-management issues

Live Trading & Performance Validation



This is an important part of the position.



We want someone who understands that a profitable backtest alone is not enough.



You should be able to help take a strategy through:



Concept → Development → Backtest → Optimization → Robustness Testing → Forward Testing → Simulation → Live Deployment → Performance Monitoring



Responsibilities may include:



Conduct realistic backtests

Account for commissions and slippage

Avoid unrealistic fills or backtesting assumptions

Identify potential overfitting

Perform out-of-sample testing

Perform walk-forward or similar robustness testing

Forward-test systems before live deployment

Analyze live execution versus historical results

Troubleshoot discrepancies between backtest and live performance

Monitor slippage and order execution

Improve system stability and reliability

Help establish appropriate risk parameters for live accounts

Maintain accurate strategy versions and performance records



Our objective is to develop strategies capable of establishing credible, verifiable live track records, rather than relying solely on hypothetical backtests.



The developer should understand the importance of maintaining appropriate documentation and broker-generated performance records and never fabricating or overstating live results.



Futures Trading Knowledge



Strong futures knowledge is highly preferred.



You should understand:



NQ / MNQ

ES / MES

GC / MGC

CL

Futures contracts

Tick size and tick value

Contract sizing

Position sizing

Long and short trades

Market, limit, stop, and stop-limit orders

Slippage

Commissions

P&L

Win rate

Profit factor

Average winner / average loser

Risk-to-reward

Maximum drawdown

Trailing drawdown

Sharpe and other performance metrics

Equity curves

Daily loss limits

Prop firm risk requirements

Live brokerage trading



You should be able to look beyond total net profit and determine whether a strategy has a realistic and commercially viable risk profile.



NinjaTrader Expertise



Strong experience with NinjaTrader 8 is required.



You should be comfortable working with:



NinjaScript

C#

NinjaTrader Editor

Strategy Analyzer

Market Replay

Playback

Historical and real-time data

OnBarUpdate()

OnOrderUpdate()

OnExecutionUpdate()

BarsInProgress

Multiple data series

Calculate modes

Tick Replay

Session templates

Trading hours

Strategy states

Managed order handling

Unmanaged order handling where appropriate

Live account execution

Simulation accounts

Brokerage connections



You should understand the differences between historical processing, backtesting, playback, simulation, and live execution.



Strategy Research & Optimization



We want someone who can contribute intellectually to strategy development rather than simply waiting to receive exact coding instructions.



You should be able to:



Evaluate trading ideas

Identify weaknesses in strategy logic

Suggest improvements

Analyze performance distributions

Analyze drawdown characteristics

Determine whether an optimization is likely overfit

Test multiple market conditions

Evaluate performance across different periods

Help determine appropriate risk configurations

Develop different strategy presets when appropriate

Help determine which configurations should be deployed to live accounts



Experience with quantitative research, systematic trading, statistical analysis, Python, or data analysis is a major advantage.



Product & High-Ticket Offer Strategy



This developer will also work with management on the commercial strategy behind the automated trading systems.



You will not necessarily be responsible for closing sales, but we want someone who understands how the technical product contributes to a premium offer.



You may help us:



Determine which strategy configurations should become customer-facing products

Develop different risk profiles and system presets

Identify the most meaningful performance statistics to present to prospects

Explain the technical differentiators of the system

Help our sales team understand how the strategies operate

Prepare technical information for product demonstrations

Help create clear explanations of strategy logic without exposing proprietary intellectual property

Identify features that could increase the value of the product

Help determine how the product should be positioned for serious futures traders

Assist management with the technical side of a high-ticket automated trading offer



The goal is to create a product where the software, live performance history, risk controls, documentation, onboarding experience, and sales presentation all support the value of the offering.



Marketing and sales materials must accurately distinguish live results, simulated results, and hypothetical/backtested performance.



Prop Firm & Live Brokerage Knowledge



Experience with both environments is highly preferred.



You should understand the differences between:



Prop Firm Trading



Funded accounts

Evaluation accounts

Trailing drawdown

Daily loss limits

Consistency requirements

Contract limits



and:



Live Brokerage Trading



Real capital

Brokerage connections

Commissions

Slippage

Order routing

Live fills

Account-level risk management



Experience with NinjaTrader Brokerage and Tradovate is a major plus.



AI & Codex Experience



Experience using OpenAI Codex or similar AI-assisted development tools is highly preferred.



We want a developer who knows how to use modern AI development tools to:



Accelerate development

Debug NinjaScript

Refactor code

Build internal tools

Analyze logs

Create testing utilities

Develop reporting tools

Work with APIs and integrations

Automate repetitive development processes



AI should accelerate your work—not replace your understanding of C#, NinjaTrader, or trading-system architecture.



Requirements



The ideal candidate has:



Strong NinjaTrader 8 experience

Strong NinjaScript experience

Strong C# development skills

Previous automated strategy development experience

Understanding of futures markets

Understanding of algorithmic/systematic trading

Experience with backtesting and forward testing

Experience deploying strategies in live or realistic trading environments

Strong understanding of risk management

Strong debugging skills

Ability to analyze trading statistics

Ability to document work clearly

Excellent communication

Ability to work directly with management

Ability to think strategically rather than simply complete coding tickets

High attention to detail

Ability to protect proprietary source code and trading logic

Major Plus

Quantitative research experience

Python

SQL

APIs

Git/GitHub

OpenAI Codex

Brokerage APIs

Prop firm experience

Trading-system licensing or protection experience

Software product development experience

Who We're Looking For



We want someone who can do more than say:



"The backtest looks profitable."



We want someone who can ask:



Is the strategy robust?



Is it overfit?



What happens after commissions and slippage?



Does it behave correctly in live execution?



What is the realistic drawdown?



How should position sizing change based on account size?



Can this system establish a credible live performance history?



What would make this system valuable enough to become a premium commercial product?



That is the level of developer we are looking for.



When Applying, Please Answer

How many years have you worked with NinjaTrader 8 and NinjaScript?

Please describe automated futures strategies you have previously developed.

Have any strategies you developed been deployed to live brokerage accounts?

What experience do you have with NinjaTrader Brokerage or Tradovate?

Have you developed systems specifically for prop firms?

What experience do you have with Python, APIs, GitHub, or Codex?

Please provide examples of previous NinjaTrader work or code samples you are legally permitted to share.

Please describe one automated system you helped take from initial concept through live deployment.

How would you evaluate whether a trading system is strong enough to become a premium/high-ticket commercial product?



We are looking for a long-term developer who can help KJD Capital build serious automated futures products—not simply complete one-off NinjaScript projects.

The content will vary. Some days I may send fitness/gym footage that needs to be turned into a clean Reel. Other times I may send lifestyle clips, trending videos I want recreated, talking clips, funny content, or random footage that simply needs to be turned into an engaging short-form video. There may occasionally be UGC-style content as well.



I need an editor who understands modern short-form content and can take raw clips plus basic instructions or a reference video and quickly turn them into finished content.



You should be comfortable with:



• Instagram Reels and TikTok editing  

• Recreating/reference-matching trending short-form videos

• Lifestyle content

• Following reference videos closely when I provide them  

• Using your own creative judgment when instructions are not extremely detailed  

• Making revisions quickly when necessary  



**TURNAROUND TIME IS VERY IMPORTANT.**



I am specifically looking for someone who can regularly complete edits within approximately **6–12 hours** of receiving the footage/instructions.



I want someone who is hungry for work, dependable, communicates well, and wants the opportunity to receive a consistent amount of editing work. As my content continues to grow, there is potential for significantly more videos and hours.

If I like a test edit and d
 to use/post the finished video, **that test edit will be paid**.

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant — Recruiting Operations

US Eastern hours  ·  Remote (Philippines)  ·  Full-time, long-term

We’re a US-based recruiting and RPO firm hiring at volume for skilled-trades and manufacturing clients, and we need an Executive Assistant who runs our operation like it’s their own — someone who anticipates what the team needs before we ask and keeps everything moving without being told. You’ll be the operational right hand to our account manager and recruiters. We have plenty of process; what we need is the judgment to run it and the ownership to get ahead of problems before they land on someone’s desk.

The person we’re looking for

You think in outcomes, not tickets. When a recruiter forgets to update the tracker, you catch it before the recap is due and chase it down. When a role has sat untouched, you flag it. When the same error keeps recurring, you don’t just fix it — you tell us how to stop it. You hold the moving pieces so the team doesn’t have to, and you stay calm when five things hit at once because you know which one matters first.

What you’ll own

● A clean, current pipeline — resumes uploaded and filed in our ATS (Workable), duplicates caught, statuses accurate as roles open and close

● Data the team can trust — hiring spreadsheets, tracker, and ATS kept in sync, with discrepancies surfaced before they become problems

● New roles ready before they’re needed — postings, interview guides, and Indeed projects built from our templates ahead of demand

● Interviews without friction — you own the scheduling logistics and stay ahead of reschedules and no-shows

● Reporting on time, every time — you assemble our weekly client recaps and operations report, chasing what’s missing so the account manager can review and send

● A team a step ahead — you anticipate what’s coming, prep the recurring meetings, and raise what needs attention before it turns urgent

Long-term seat with real ownership on one dedicated account team — not a rotating gig. You’ll start with a defined scope and take on more as you earn trust.

One clarification: you won’t screen candidates, make hiring decisions, or handle client calls — those stay with our recruiters and account manager. Everything that keeps the operation a step ahead of the team is yours to own.

What you’ll need

● Experience as an executive assistant or right-hand to a busy leader or team — real responsibility, genuine autonomy

● A track record of anticipating needs and owning outcomes, not just completing assigned tasks

● Hands-on database experience and confident Google Sheets / Excel skills

● Sharp attention to detail and excellent written English

● The judgment to know when to run the playbook, when to improve it, and when to raise a flag

Nice to have: Executive supporting experience

Schedule & setup

Full-time, US Eastern business hours — an evening-to-overnight shift in the Philippines, with guaranteed overlap through the US morning. Requires reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection and backup power (UPS or generator).

How to apply

Start your message with the word PRECISION so we know you actually read this. Then send your resume and tell us about one time you saw something your team or manager needed before they asked for it — and how you handled it.

* Body

must remain consistent.

Experience with tools such as Kling, Higgsfield, Veo, Seedream, Nano Banana, Runway, ComfyUI, LoRAs, FaceFusion, ElevenLabs or similar tools is a major advantage.

2. Two reference Reels



Your task is to **recreate both Reels using our model.**



The goal is NOT to simply copy the original video.



You must recreate the concept while replacing the person with our character.



The GDrive:

* Use our model

* Maintain extremely high character consistency - with the same tattoos

* Recreate the movements / concept of the reference Reel

* Change the outfit

* Avoid obvious AI artifacts

That is the quality level we are looking for.



---

title: Behavioral health biller/denial management
description:
MEDICAL BILLING ACCOUNT MANAGER

Escalations & Denial Management — Remote (Philippines-based)



ROLE DESCRIPTION



This is an escalations and denial management role — not daily claims submission or routine billing tasks. The account manager handles claims that are stuck, denied, underpaid, or aging: identifying the root cause and driving them to resolution. This role oversees the billing team's work on assigned accounts, identifies issues, coordinates solutions, and ensures problem claims actually get resolved.



Availability is required during normal business hours (Mountain Time, US) for escalations, insurance calls, and coordination with the India-based billing team.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE — NON-NEGOTIABLE



This is a specialized role, not entry-level. Candidates must have direct, hands-on experience in ALL of the following:



- Mental health / behavioral health credentialing — enrolling and re-credentialing providers with payers

- Mental health billing specifically (psychiatry, therapy, TMS, or substance abuse billing) — not general medical billing

- Denial management — identifying denial root causes, working appeals, and preventing repeat denials

- Practice reporting — building and interpreting AR, denial-trend, and revenue reports for a practice



Do not apply without direct experience in all four areas above.



EMPLOYMENT



- Independent contractor, remote, Philippines-based

- Reports directly to the business owner and works alongside a 15-person billing team in India

- Requires a dedicated home workspace with reliable internet

- Must be able to handle credentialing for mental health providers



SCHEDULE



- Flexible workload throughout the day

- Required availability during Mountain Time business hours

- Most non-urgent messages should receive a response within 1–2 hours

- Flexibility to step away when there are no active issues requiring attention

- Daily audits and account hygiene must be completed that day, not at a specific time

- Scheduled internal team meetings must be attended

- All projects and hours are tracked in Clockify



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



- Audit approximately 2 client accounts per day

- Review 30, 60, 90+ day AR

- Review denials, rejections, unpaid and high-dollar claims — the core focus of the role

- Work and resolve escalated claims and insurance follow-up

- Handle credentialing for mental health providers

- Perform account hygiene and identify revenue leakage

- Coordinate with the India billing team to resolve issues

- Verify that assigned work was actually completed

- Build and maintain practice-level reporting (AR, denial trends, revenue)

- Handle miscellaneous/special projects such as credentialing and research

- Escalate complex issues requiring additional US-level intervention



PERFORMANCE



Success is measured by maintaining 95%+ claim acceptance across all managed clients.

title: VIRTUAL LEGAL ASSISTANT FOR TEAM LOCATED IN EASTERN, US
description:
Remote Virtual Assistant for Growing Legal Firm - Estate Planning and Administration:



Hours of Work:          9 am – 4 pm EST, Monday - Friday

Compensation/Hr: $7-10 based on trial period results

Start Date:          On or before October 15th (following a paid trial)



THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a calm, clear, and focused individual, with prior experience as a virtual legal assistant in the United States or comparable legal education, who is fueled by providing excellent service to aid prospective and existing clients meet their needs in conjunction with our high-value efficiency focused firm.



A self-driven person who has set a high accountability standard for themselves to be their best personally and professionally will contribute to our equally driven law firm at the highest level.  We invite you to apply.



WHAT WE DO

Our firm led by our primary value of integrity, seeks to do our best through mutual respect and consistent progressive improvement.  While supporting one another’s growth, we provide legal services to our surrounding communities in the areas of estate planning and probate/trust administration.  In essence, we help create the legal design to protect our clients, their families, and the hard-earned assets they’ve worked their lives to achieve.  Then, we support them in either changing or following through with the “final” plan at the relevant shifts in life.



WORK WITH AMAZING PEOPLE

WE WANT TO MEET YOU BECAUSE YOU ARE

2. A master of the calendar whose natural state is to be organized.

3. Trustworthy and can be counted on to safeguard confidentiality.

5. Able to balance competing demands while keeping calm.

Plus to know: Active Campaign; Acuity; Adobe; Asana; LEAP; Simplifile

• Exceptional written and oral English skills;

o Show us what you have!

title: High-Ticket Futures Trading Sales Closer + CRM / Marketing / NinjaTrader Specialist
description:
KJD Capital is looking for an experienced, highly capable individual who can become a true right-hand person to the CEO.



This is NOT a basic virtual assistant position.



We are a small, growing company, and right now we operate with a very lean team. Because of that, I am looking for someone versatile who can work closely with me across sales, trading, CRM, marketing, funnels, and general business operations.



My name is Kyle, CEO and Founder of KJD Capital. I currently handle many different areas of the business myself, and I am looking for someone I can rely on to help manage different responsibilities, take ownership of projects, and step in when I am focused on something else.



I am not looking for someone who only wants to complete assigned tasks.



I am looking for someone who can eventually become a dependable right-hand person who understands the business, thinks independently, and can help me improve it as we grow.



Your Primary Responsibilities



A major part of this position will be high-ticket sales closing through face-to-face Zoom calls.



You must be comfortable speaking directly with prospective clients, understanding their goals, explaining our automated futures trading systems, handling objections, negotiating, following up, and confidently asking for the sale.



You may also help with:

Cold calls

Zoom sales calls and product demonstrations

NinjaTrader demonstrations

Lead qualification and appointment setting

High-ticket sales closing

Sales negotiation and objection handling

GoHighLevel CRM management

Pipeline management and lead follow-up

Automations and workflows

Meta Ads

Marketing strategy

Landing pages and funnels

Website improvement

Conversion-rate improvement

Sales scripts and follow-up processes

Customer onboarding coordination

General business operations

Providing ideas and recommendations for improving the company



Because we are a smaller company, versatility is very important.



Some days you may be focused on sales calls. Other days you may be improving the CRM, checking a funnel, helping with an ad campaign, reviewing follow-up processes, or helping solve another business problem.



Futures Trading Knowledge Is Extremely Important



You MUST understand futures trading terminology and be able to speak intelligently about the markets.



You should understand concepts such as:



Futures contracts, ES, NQ, CL, GC, points, ticks, contracts, position sizing, risk management, drawdown, win rate, percentage return, P&L, brokerage accounts, live accounts, simulated accounts, prop firms, funded accounts, evaluation accounts, trading strategies, automated trading systems, and strategy performance.



You need to be comfortable discussing performance in both dollar terms and percentages.



For example, if a prospect asks about percentage returns, contract sizing, risk, drawdown, brokerage connections, or how a futures strategy operates, you need to understand the question and be able to communicate clearly.



Our prospects are traders.



If you do not understand what you are talking about, they will recognize it quickly, and that can hurt the reputation of the company.



For that reason, real trading knowledge is one of the most important requirements for this position.



NinjaTrader Experience



Strong experience with NinjaTrader is highly preferred.



You should ideally know how to:



Navigate NinjaTrader confidently

Understand charts and strategies

Understand automated strategies

Explain strategy performance

Understand brokerage connections

Understand live vs. simulated trading

Navigate accounts and executions

Discuss futures contracts confidently

Demonstrate the platform during Zoom calls



If you have experience developing NinjaTrader strategies or working with NinjaScript, that is a major advantage.



Sales Experience



You need REAL sales ability.



We are looking for someone who knows how to:



Build rapport quickly

Control a sales conversation

Ask intelligent discovery questions

Identify the prospect's actual objection

Explain value without sounding scripted

Negotiate professionally

Handle price objections

Follow up persistently without being annoying

Create urgency appropriately

Confidently close high-ticket offers



You should be comfortable speaking with people face-to-face over Zoom.



You must have excellent English, strong communication skills, and a professional appearance on camera.



You should sound confident, knowledgeable, and credible.



We do not want someone who sounds like they are reading a script.



We want someone who understands the product, understands the industry, and knows how to have a real sales conversation.



GoHighLevel / CRM Knowledge



You should have strong experience with GoHighLevel.



This includes:



Pipelines

Opportunities

Contacts

Workflows

Automations

Calendars

Appointment booking

SMS/email follow-ups

Lead nurturing

Tags

Pipeline stages

Reporting

CRM organization



I want someone who can look at our CRM and identify ways to make our sales process more efficient and organized.



Meta Ads, Funnels & Marketing



Experience with Meta Ads is strongly preferred.



You should understand:



 and Instagram advertising

Lead generation

Targeting

Retargeting

Creatives

Ad copy

Landing pages

Funnels

Conversion rates

Cost per lead

Cost per booked call

Follow-up sequences

Website optimization



Experience building or improving websites and landing pages is also a major plus.



AI & Technology



Experience using advanced AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar tools is valuable, especially if you know how to use AI to improve business processes, marketing, development, research, or automation.



If you have coding experience, especially involving NinjaTrader, NinjaScript, APIs, automation, or AI-assisted development, mention that in your application.



However, AI should enhance your knowledge — it should not replace it.



IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE APPLYING



Do NOT copy this entire job listing into AI and submit an AI-generated application.



We are specifically looking for someone with real trading, sales, CRM, and marketing knowledge.



If your application is clearly generic or generated entirely by AI, you will not be considered.



During the interview, we will ask detailed questions about futures trading, NinjaTrader, sales, GoHighLevel, Meta Ads, and marketing.



You must be able to answer those questions yourself.



We are looking for someone who genuinely knows what they are doing — not someone who can simply generate good-looking answers.



Who We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is someone who is:



Highly intelligent, commercially minded, confident, organized, dependable, technically capable, comfortable with responsibility, excellent with clients, and capable of working independently.



Because we are still a small company, I especially value someone who is willing to wear multiple hats and help wherever their skills can make the business better.



I want someone who can eventually understand the company well enough that I can say:



“Take care of this for me.”



And know that it will actually get handled properly.



You will be working closely with the CEO, so there is an opportunity to become an important part of the company as we continue developing and growing.



How to Apply



Please send a 2–3 minute video introduction.



Do not overproduce it. We want to hear you speak naturally.



In your video, tell us:



Your name and professional background.

Your futures trading knowledge.

Your NinjaTrader experience.

Your high-ticket sales experience.

Your experience closing sales over Zoom.

Your GoHighLevel experience.

Your Meta Ads experience.

Your funnel, website, or marketing experience.

Whether you have ever developed or worked with NinjaTrader strategies.

Any experience you have with Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, coding, automation, or AI tools.

Why you believe you could become a strong right-hand person to the CEO of KJD Capital.



Also include examples of previous work, results, sales experience, CRM builds, funnels, advertising campaigns, trading experience, or other relevant projects when available.



Final Note



KJD Capital is not a huge corporate operation.



We are a small company building something we believe has significant potential, and I am looking for someone who wants to come in early, contribute across multiple areas, and grow alongside the business.



This position has a high standard because the person we hire will represent KJD Capital directly in front of prospective clients.



Trading knowledge cannot be faked. Sales ability cannot be faked.



If you genuinely understand futures trading, can sell professionally, know NinjaTrader, understand GoHighLevel and digital marketing, and want to work closely with a founder while helping build and improve a company, we want to hear from you.

title: YOUTUBE EDITOR
description:
LONG FORM YOUTUBE EDITOR WANTED (RETENTION FOCUSED, FITNESS/PERSONAL BRAND)



ABOUT THE CHANNEL



I run DobsTrainingClub, an online 1 to 1 fitness coaching business.

Ex British Army, now based in Bali, coaching a UK client base.

12k on Instagram and launching the YouTube channel now.



The content is a mix of fat loss education, my own story, and client

interviews. Talking head led, story driven, built to hold attention.

I want one editor who owns this channel long term, not a rotation of

freelancers.



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



8 to 15 minute long form videos, roughly 4 per month to start.

Talking head pieces to camera (Sony ZV E10 footage)

Sit down client interviews

Story led personal brand videos



WHAT ACTUALLY MATTERS TO ME



Retention. Not transitions, not colour grading, not showing off.

Every cut should earn the next 10 seconds.



That means:

Tight pacing with no dead air

Pattern interrupts before attention drops

B roll, screenshots and text on screen used to hold the point, not decorate it

Sound design and music that carries energy without burying the voice

Captions that are clean and readable, never cluttering the frame



If you can look at a video and tell me where people are dropping off and

why, you are the person I want.



HOW WE'LL WORK



Everything lands in a Google Drive folder: raw footage, the script, and a

reference video I want the edit to feel like. Your job is to replicate that

reference closely, then bring your own judgement on top.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
# Senior Graphic Designer — Full-Time Remote



**Location:** Philippines — Remote

**Position:** Full-Time

**Compensation:** $1,500–$2,000 USD/month, based on experience and portfolio

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday with some overlap with U.S. Central Time

**Long-term position**



We are looking for an exceptional **Senior Graphic Designer** to become a long-term member of our creative and marketing team.



This is not a virtual assistant position and we are not looking for someone who simply creates graphics from Canva templates.



We want a designer with excellent visual taste who can take a brand, understand its personality, and create polished marketing materials that look intentional, premium, and consistent.



You will work across several established brands in the **health & wellness, pet, lifestyle, and consumer-product industries**.



## What You’ll Design



Projects will include:



* Social media graphics

* Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising creative

* Marketing campaigns

* Website graphics

* Landing-page assets

*
 marketing graphics

* Presentation decks

* Digital brochures and PDFs

* Product marketing materials

* Infographics

* Brand assets and templates

* Sales and educational materials

* Other digital creative projects across multiple brands



You will often receive a concept, copy, photos, and brand direction — and we expect you to turn those ingredients into something excellent.



We want someone who can **think creatively**, not someone who needs every design decision explained.



## What We're Looking For



You should have:



* 5+ years of professional graphic-design experience

* A strong professional portfolio

* Excellent typography skills

* Strong understanding of hierarchy, spacing, composition, and color

* Experience working within established brand guidelines

* Ability to work across multiple brands without making them all look the same

* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong written English

* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines

* Comfortable receiving creative feedback and making revisions quickly



## Software Skills



Strong experience with:



* Adobe Photoshop

* Adobe Illustrator

* Adobe InDesign

* Canva

* Figma



Experience with **video editing or motion graphics is a plus, but it is not required for this position.**



Experience with any of the following is helpful:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* After Effects

* CapCut

* AI image-generation/design tools

* AI-assisted creative workflows



We are actively incorporating AI into our marketing and creative processes, so we are especially interested in designers who see AI as a tool that can make great designers even better.



## The Designer We're Looking For



You probably enjoy looking at great branding and advertising outside of work.



You notice when typography is slightly wrong.



You understand that premium design often means knowing what **not** to add.



You can look at an existing brand and quickly understand what belongs — and what doesn't.



And when someone gives you a rough concept, your instinct is to make it substantially better.



## What This Position Is NOT



This is not:



* A VA position with occasional graphic design

* A Canva-template production job

* A short-term freelance project

* A position where you will only execute exact instructions



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of our creative team for the long term.



## Compensation



Starting compensation is expected to be approximately:



**$1,500–$2,000 USD per month**



Final compensation will depend on experience, portfolio quality, creative ability, and skill set.



Exceptional candidates may have opportunities for increased compensation and responsibility over time.



## Paid Design Test



Final candidates will be invited to complete a **small paid design assignment**.



Every finalist will receive the same brief so we can evaluate:



* Creative thinking

* Visual taste

* Typography

* Brand interpretation

* Attention to detail

* Ability to follow a brief



We do not ask candidates to complete extensive unpaid design work.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. A link to your portfolio.

2. Your resume or LinkedIn profile.

3. Your current monthly compensation or desired monthly compensation.

4. Your availability to begin.

5. Your normal working hours and how much overlap you can provide with U.S. Central Time.

6. The design software you use regularly.

7. If applicable, any experience you have with video editing, motion graphics, or AI creative tools.



### Please also answer these three questions:



**1. What project in your portfolio best represents your design ability, and why?**



**2. If you are given brand guidelines, copy, photos, and a rough creative idea, how do you normally approach the project?**



**3. What brands or designers do you think are producing excellent creative work right now?**



Please put the words **“DESIGN MATTERS”** at the beginning of your application so we know you carefully read the entire posting.



We are looking for one outstanding designer — not the largest number of applicants.



If you're passionate about great design and want a stable, long-term opportunity where your creative ability will matter, we'd like to see your work.

title: Walmart Seller Product Hunting specialist

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Walmart Product Sourcing Specialist to help identify profitable products for our Walmart Marketplace business.



The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Walmart product hunting, Online Arbitrage (OA), and Wholesale sourcing. You should understand how to research products, analyze profitability, and identify opportunities suitable for both Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) and Seller Fulfilled orders.



Responsibilities



• Research and identify profitable products to sell on Walmart Marketplace

• Source products through Online Arbitrage and Wholesale suppliers

• Conduct detailed product hunting and competitor research

• Analyze sales price, product cost, Walmart fees, shipping costs, ROI, and profit margins

• Identify products suitable for WFS and Seller Fulfilled

• Research product demand, competition, pricing history, and seller count

• Find reliable retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and suppliers

• Maintain organized sourcing and product research spreadsheets

• Monitor existing products for pricing and profitability changes

• Look for new sourcing opportunities and profitable product categories



Requirements



• Previous experience sourcing products for Walmart Marketplace

• Strong experience with Online Arbitrage and/or Wholesale sourcing

• Experience with Walmart WFS and Seller Fulfilled products

• Strong product hunting and research skills

• Ability to calculate ROI, profit margins, fees, and other costs accurately

• Familiarity with Walmart Seller Center and product research tools is preferred

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

• Good written and spoken English

• Strong attention to detail

• Hardworking, reliable, and self-motivated

• Able to work independently without constant supervision

• Must be consistent and willing to meet sourcing/product research goals



We are looking for someone who understands profitable sourcing, not simply finding products. The candidate should be able to evaluate opportunities carefully and provide products that meet our profitability and sourcing requirements.



Experience with Amazon sourcing, Keepa, SellerAmp, or similar product research tools is a plus.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
About Cove Health



Cove Health is a health technology company pioneering a new category: Healthcare Advocacy as a Service.

When an insurance plan denies a medication, stalls a prior authorization, or issues a “not medically necessary” decision, patients are often left to navigate a complicated healthcare system on their own. Cove Health changes that.

We pair patients with a licensed physician, supported by our proprietary AI software, who reviews the case and drafts a rigorous, guideline-cited advocacy letter on the patient’s behalf.



We are not a law firm. We are building the resource that should have existed years ago: someone in the patient’s corner who understands how to speak the system’s language.



Learn more at 
.



The Role



We are looking for a Marketing Lead to help build Cove Health’s marketing function from the ground up.



Right now, many of the people who need Cove Health do not know that a service like ours exists. They are searching online for answers after receiving a denied claim, struggling with a prior authorization, or trying to understand how to appeal an insurance decision.



Your job is to help make sure they find Cove Health — and trust us when they do.



This is a hands-on role for someone who can think strategically and execute independently. You will help shape how Cove Health shows up across search, content, social media, public relations, partnerships, community engagement, and lifecycle marketing.



You should be comfortable moving between strategy and execution. We are not looking for someone whose primary experience is managing agencies or delegating marketing work. We want someone who can develop the plan and do the work required to execute it.



Because healthcare and insurance are sensitive and regulated areas, strong judgment is essential. We want marketing that gets attention without making promises we cannot substantiate.



What You Will Own



Public Relations & Earned Media



Build and execute Cove Health’s media strategy from the ground up, including press lists, pitch angles, media kits, and spokesperson positioning.



Identify opportunities for coverage across healthcare, technology, consumer finance, policy, podcasts, newsletters, and other channels that reach patients and caregivers.



Help position Cove Health as a trusted source of commentary on prior authorization, insurance claim denials, and AI-supported patient advocacy.



Handle inbound media opportunities, prepare spokespeople, and help manage communications around sensitive topics.



Brand & Positioning



Help translate “Healthcare Advocacy as a Service” into language that patients can immediately understand.



Own and continuously improve Cove Health’s voice, messaging architecture, and brand consistency across the website,
, social media, content, and other patient-facing channels.



Ensure our marketing consistently reinforces the trust signals that matter: physician-led, guideline-cited, transparent, and careful about what we can and cannot promise.



Content & SEO



Own organic search strategy around high-intent topics such as:



Denied insurance claims

Prior authorization appeals

Step-therapy overrides

Formulary exceptions

Independent medical review

Medication and treatment denials



Develop useful, plain-English content that helps patients understand their options while improving Cove Health’s organic visibility.



Manage the editorial process from beginning to end, including research, content briefs, drafting, physician review, publishing, optimization, and content refreshes.



Social Media & Community



Build Cove Health’s presence where patients and caregivers actually spend time, including patient advocacy communities, condition-specific communities, Reddit, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and X.



Our approach should be helpful and credible rather than overly promotional.



Develop a repeatable content engine that may include short-form video, educational posts, explainers, patient-focused resources, and anonymized case outcomes.



Partnerships & Lifecycle Marketing



Develop relationships with patient advocacy organizations, disease foundations, chronic-illness creators, benefits consultants, independent healthcare providers, and other relevant partners.



Help build lifecycle
 campaigns and referral systems that turn patients into repeat users, members, and advocates for Cove Health.



Create and optimize landing pages, tracking systems, and reporting so we can understand which channels and campaigns are producing meaningful results.



Measurement & Optimization



Define and track the metrics that matter, including qualified traffic, signup rate, cost per acquired case, membership conversion, share of voice, media placements, and channel performance.



Establish a disciplined test-and-learn process.



We are operating with a startup mindset. We expect you to test ideas, measure results, double down on what works, and stop spending time on what does not.



Your First 90 Days



Days 1–30: Audit our website, funnel, messaging, search landscape, and existing marketing efforts. Learn the Cove Health product, speak with leadership and physicians, and develop a prioritized messaging and channel strategy.



Days 31–60: Begin shipping. Establish the SEO content engine, activate and strengthen social channels, build the press list and media kit, and begin outreach.



Days 61–90: Begin generating measurable traction through earned media, organic search, social/community engagement, partnerships, and other acquisition channels. Identify the channels showing the strongest potential for repeatable case volume.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone with:



5+ years of experience in marketing, communications, public relations, growth, content, or a related field.

Hands-on experience working in an early-stage, startup, or resource-constrained environment.



Demonstrated earned-media experience, including placements you personally helped secure.



Excellent English writing and communication skills.



Strong copywriting ability across pitches, landing pages, articles, guides, scripts,
s, and social content.



Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals and content strategy.



Experience growing organic traffic through content or search.



Comfort working with analytics, attribution, GA4 or similar tools, and imperfect data.



Strong research skills and attention to detail.



Excellent judgment when communicating about healthcare, insurance, or other sensitive subjects.



The ability to work independently in a remote environment with limited supervision.



A strong bias toward execution. You do not just recommend what should be done — you can actually do it.



Nice to Have



Experience in any of the following is especially valuable:

Healthcare

Health insurance

Digital health or health technology

Patient advocacy

Chronic-illness communities

Health policy

Other regulated consumer industries

Short-form video production

Public relations and journalist outreach

Marketing a new category or unfamiliar service

Building a marketing function from an early stage

Existing relationships with healthcare, technology, consumer, or policy reporters are also a plus.



How We Work



Cove Health is a fully remote company.



We operate synchronously by default, with regular working sessions and direct access to leadership.



This is an execution-focused environment. If you propose something that makes sense, we expect to move quickly and ship it.

title: Virtual Assistant – Provider Network, CRM & Marketing Support
description:
Maia Women’s Health (

Maia Women’s Health is building a more connected model of women’s healthcare through a personalized digital health platform and a collaborative network of trusted healthcare and wellness providers. As our provider network grows, we’re looking for someone who can help us stay organized, maintain consistent communication, and make sure prospective and onboarding providers don’t fall through the cracks.



The primary focus of this role will be supporting our Provider Affiliate Network and managing our provider pipeline in HubSpot. You’ll work closely with Maia’s Provider Network Lead to assist with provider outreach, follow-up, onboarding, scheduling, CRM management, and other administrative projects.



We’re looking for someone who is dependable, detail-oriented, communicates exceptionally well, and can eventually take ownership of recurring tasks without needing step-by-step direction every time.



Key Responsibilities



Provider Network & Outreach



* Research prospective healthcare and wellness providers who may be a good fit for the Maia Provider Affiliate Network

* Build and maintain organized provider prospect lists

* Send provider outreach
s using established templates and messaging

* Personalize outreach when appropriate

* Follow up with prospective providers who have not responded

* Track provider applications and onboarding progress

* Send onboarding materials, reminders, and next steps

* Follow up with providers who have incomplete onboarding requirements

* Respond to basic provider questions and escalate questions when needed

* Schedule provider calls and coordinate calendars

* Help maintain warm, professional communication with Maia’s provider community



HubSpot & CRM Management

* Identify providers who require follow-up

* Create and maintain contact lists and segments

* Assist with HubSpot
 templates, sequences, campaigns, and basic workflows

* Track outreach and onboarding activity

Administrative & Operations Support



* Maintain spreadsheets, documents, provider lists, and internal resources

* Assist with scheduling and calendar coordination

* Organize files and information so they are easy for the team to access

* Assist with
 organization and administrative follow-up

* Help create and document repeatable processes as Maia grows

* Support other provider network and administrative projects as needed



Social Media & Marketing Support — Bonus



If you have experience or interest in social media, there may also be opportunities to help with Maia’s marketing efforts. This is a bonus rather than the primary responsibility of the role.



Social media support could include:



* Scheduling Instagram and LinkedIn content

* Maintaining a content calendar

* Drafting or editing captions from provided content

* Repurposing existing content for social media

* Creating or editing simple Canva graphics using Maia’s established branding

* Organizing photos, graphics, videos, and other content assets

* Engaging appropriately with provider and community accounts

* Supporting provider recruitment and outreach campaigns

* Assisting with other basic digital marketing projects



REQUIRED SKILLS:

* Experience with HubSpot CRM

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong professional
 communication

* Excellent organization and attention to detail

* Strong follow-up and task-management skills

* Comfortable managing multiple contacts at different stages of a pipeline

* Experience with Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Calendar

* Comfortable with spreadsheets and data organization

* Experience with calendar management and scheduling

* Ability to learn new software and processes quickly

* Ability to work independently and consistently meet deadlines

* Reliable internet connection and communication

* Good judgment about when to handle something independently and when to ask for clarification



PREFERRED / BONUS EXPERIENCE:

* Healthcare, women’s health, wellness, or health-tech experience

* Provider recruitment or healthcare professional outreach

* Affiliate, community, or network management

* Startup or small-business experience

* HubSpot sequences, workflows,
 marketing, or reporting

* Canva

* Instagram and LinkedIn

* Meta Business Suite or other social scheduling tools

* Content calendar management

* Basic copywriting/editing

* Online research and lead generation



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The right person for this role is someone who genuinely enjoys keeping things organized and moving forward.



You notice when someone hasn’t responded to an
, when a provider has been sitting in the same pipeline stage for too long, when information is missing from a CRM record, or when an onboarding step hasn’t been completed—and you take initiative to determine the appropriate next step.



You should be comfortable working independently while also communicating clearly when you need direction. Attention to detail is extremely important, as you’ll be communicating with healthcare professionals and representing Maia in many of those interactions.



We care more about reliability, organization, communication, good judgment, and follow-through than having experience with every tool listed above.



An interest in women’s health and Maia’s mission is strongly preferred.



HOURS & SCHEDULE

Hours are flexible, but we prefer someone who can check in and complete tasks consistently throughout the week rather than completing all hours on one day.



Some availability during U.S. business hours is preferred for scheduling and provider communication.



COMPENSATION



$4–7 USD/hour, depending on experience and skill level.



Candidates with particularly strong HubSpot experience, excellent written English, and demonstrated ability to independently manage a CRM or outreach pipeline may be considered toward the higher end of the range.



We’re looking for someone interested in a consistent, long-term working relationship with the opportunity to grow with Maia.



WHEN APPLYING

 with the subject line “Maia Virtual Assistant Application.”

title: Client Intake Specialist — Remote (Sales Support)
description:
THE ROLE



You're the first voice a customer hears.



Someone's about to move. They're stressed, they're calling three companies,

and the first one that picks up and sounds like a real human usually wins.

That's you.



You don't have to sell. You have to be excellent on the phone and airtight

with details.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Answer every inbound call live. First ring, not voi
.

- Run a warm intake — what has them moving, where from, where to, when, size

  of home, anything special. Let people talk.

- Enter the lead into Chariot (our CRM) on the call, not later.

- Post the handoff to Slack within 5 minutes of hanging up.

- Answer basic questions from a one-page reference. Return missed calls.



You won't quote prices, build estimates, or close jobs. That's our sales

team. Your job is to catch every lead and hand it over clean.





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



- 95%+ of calls answered live during your shift

- Every lead in Chariot and on Slack within 5 minutes of hang-up

- Zero records with a missing field



A lead answered in one minute converts. The same lead at twenty minutes is

already talking to someone else. Speed is the product.





YOU'RE A FIT IF



- Your spoken English is excellent and your phone presence is genuinely warm.

- You're fluent with software on day one — CRM, Slack, Google Workspace,

  VoIP. No hand-holding. This one is non-negotiable.

- You stay calm with an emotional caller.

- You have reliable internet, a quiet space, and a good headset.



Preferred: sales, executive assistant, or team management background.



HOURS



Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday — 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM Central.

Four ten-hour days. Wednesdays and Thursdays off.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Summary

We're an established DTC ecommerce fashion brand looking for a Senior Performance Creative Strategist to help us improve and expand our creative strategy for Meta Ads.



We already have a strong backend, an established creative production system, several months of performance data, and proven winning ads. We're looking for someone with experience across multiple DTC brands who can bring outside pattern recognition, challenge our current assumptions, and help us consistently discover new winning creative directions.



**What you'll do:**



* Analyze winning and losing creatives using Meta Ads Manager

* Research customers, competitors, Meta/TikTok ads and adjacent markets

* Identify customer problems, desires, objections and buying motivations

* Develop new angles, concepts, hypotheses and testing opportunities

* Build and maintain a creative testing roadmap

* Develop strategy/briefs for UGC, gifted & paid creators, AI voiceover videos and static ads

* Systematically iterate proven winners without relying only on minor variations



We're particularly interested in someone with experience in fashion/accessories AND problem-solving/direct-response products. Our products combine fashion/desire with functional benefits, and we want to better understand the underlying problems, desires and use cases that can drive our advertising.

title: Media Buyer and Client Success Manager
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

We run Meta ads for auto detailing, paint protection film, ceramic coating and window tint shops across the United States. We have 33 active shops right now and we are adding more every month. I have been running every account myself and I am out of hours.



I am looking for one person to take the ads and the client relationship off my plate. This is not a button pusher role and it is not a chat support role. You will own accounts end to end: the ads that run, the leads they produce, and the shop owner who is counting on both.



You will work directly with me. If you are good, you grow into running the whole media buying side.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

Media buying, about 60% of the job



Build, launch and manage Meta lead generation campaigns for assigned shops

Watch cost per lead daily and act on it, not weekly and not after I ask

Write and test new angles, pull the losers, scale what is working

Keep spend pacing correct so nobody burns their budget in nine days

Report what changed and why, in plain English

Client success, about 40% of the job



Run a short weekly check in call with each of your shops

Make sure they are actually calling their leads, because most shops do not

Flag a shop that is going quiet before it becomes a cancellation

Collect the wins, the job values and the reviews so we can prove the return

WHAT I NEED YOU TO ALREADY HAVE

At least 2 years running Meta ads with real money, and you can tell me what you spent and what it produced

You understand lead generation, not ecommerce. Cost per lead, lead quality, speed to lead and booked jobs are the numbers that matter here, not ROAS on a product catalog

Clear spoken and written English. You will be on calls with American shop owners every week

You are comfortable telling a client something they do not want to hear

Reliable internet and a quiet place to take calls

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU STAND OUT

You have worked with local service businesses, home services, auto, med spa or similar

You have used GoHighLevel

You have used Make.com or Zapier

You can read a spreadsheet and find the problem in it without being told where to look

THE PAY

$800 to $1,800 USD per month depending on what you have actually done before

Monthly bonus tied to cost per lead across the accounts you own

Paid monthly. Philippine holidays respected. Paid time off after 90 days

Raises are based on the results your accounts produce, and I will tell you exactly what the target is

I do not pay a percentage of ad spend. I never will. That pays you more for spending more, and that is not the job.



HOW TO APPLY

Read this part carefully, because I delete applications that skip it.



Put "BAY DOOR" as the first word of your application.



Then send me:



One account you have run, with the real numbers. Monthly spend, cost per lead, and what happened to those leads. Screenshots are welcome.

A campaign that failed, and what you changed.

Two or three sentences on this: a shop spends $2,000 and gets 60 leads at $33 each, and books 2 jobs. Is that a good month or a bad month, and what is the first thing you would look at?

No cover letter templates. No "I am a hardworking individual." Just answer the three things above.



I read every application that follows the instructions, and I reply to the ones I want to talk to within a week.

What This Job Is

We are a local SEO agency. We handle search visibility for automotive shops across the US.



We do the research. We analyze every client and their competitors, and we build the link plan before you touch anything. Every platform, directory, and profile is listed out for you.



You execute that list. Your job is to do it correctly, log it properly, and not cut corners.



This is repetitive, detailed work. Some people hate that. Some people are great at it and like the calm of a clear process. We are looking for the second kind, and we will keep you long term.



Your Day

Directory and profile submissions. Create the account, fill the profile completely, including categories, description, hours, photos, and services. Drop the link, then verify it went live. A half filled profile is a wasted submission.



Citations and NAP consistency. Submit listings matching our master record exactly, character for character. Flag duplicates and outdated listings.



Outreach. Find the right contact at a target site, send our template, personalize the first line, run the follow ups, log every reply.



Link reclamation. Chase unlinked brand mentions, broken links, and links that dropped or went nofollow.



Tracker updates, every single day. Every task logged in Airtable with a status and the live URL. This is the thing we will evaluate you on hardest.



What You Will NOT Do

Touch any client's Google Business Profile

Decide which sites to target or what the strategy is

Talk directly to clients

Anything that needs a decision gets flagged to us. You never guess.



What We Give You

AdsPower browser profile for each client, already set up

Dedicated residential proxy for each client

Dedicated
 for each client

Airtable base with your task list and tracker

Full client pack with NAP, descriptions, categories, logos, photos, and service lists

Written SOPs for every task type, and outreach templates already written

You are not figuring this out alone. Everything is documented.



Requirements

Prior experience with citations, directory submissions, or link building. Tell us exactly what you did, not what you have heard of

Obsessed with detail. You notice when one listing says "St." and another says "Street," and you know why that matters

Written English good enough to send a professional outreach

Reliable internet, and a machine that can run several browser profiles at once

Able to work from a task list without being chased

4 or more hours overlapping US business hours. For most of you that means a late night or very early morning shift. Be honest with yourself about this before applying

Helps, but not required: AdsPower or any other similar tools. Airtable. Experience across multiple client accounts at once.



Do Not Apply If

You cannot do the overlap hours consistently

You are juggling three other clients and this would be your fourth. We need your working day, not your leftovers

You will not put your camera on for an interview

Paid Trial

Before we hire, we pay you for a short trial. Ten citation submissions for one client, using our browser profile, our client info, and our tracker.



Do the work exactly the way you would do it on a normal day. Takes most people 1 to 2 hours. We will agree the amount before you start.



How To Apply

Subject line: CITATION [YOUR CITY] Example: CITATION Cebu



Answer these in the body. Keep your whole application under 300 words. Short answers are fine. We are hiring for attention to detail, not essay length.



1. A client's address is listed as "1420 N Main St, Suite B." One directory only has a single address field, no suite line. What do you enter, and why?



2. A directory requires a phone call or SMS to verify the listing, but you do not have access to the client's phone. What do you do?



3. Paste the live URL of one listing or profile you personally created, for a past client or for your own business. It must be online right now. We will click it.



4. Have you ever used NAPSync Directory? If yes, tell us what you used it for. If no, just say no.



5. Tell us about one listing you submitted that got rejected or removed. What was the reason?



Then add two lines:



Your monthly rate

The hours you can work, in Philippine time

No portfolio dump, no client list. If we want those, we will ask on the call.

title: High-Ticket Account Manager | US Clients - $1,500–$2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.
